title: Hourly Paid IT Instructor – UCA
description:
Role Summary
The IT instructor is responsible for delivering high-quality, competency-based programmes in Networking, Cyber Security, and related IT disciplines, aligned with industry standards and professional certification pathways such as CompTIA Network+, CCNA, Security+ and CEH certifications. The position exists to equip learners with the technical knowledge, skills, and professional competencies required for further education, certification, and employment in the IT and cyber security sectors.
The position is responsible for effective instruction, learner assessment, academic support, technical mentoring, and development of relevant course materials and learning resources, while contributing to curriculum development and continuous improvement of programme delivery.
The IT Instructor supports the effective management of networking laboratories and learning technologies, ensuring appropriate, secure, and reliable learning environments.
Working collaboratively with the Learning Centre Coordinator, Students Services Officer, and Manager of Academic Affairs (MAA), the IT Instructor contributes to quality assurance, learner engagement, programme delivery, and continuous improvement, while ensuring compliance with SPCE-UCA policies, safeguarding requirements, and academic standards.

Duties and Responsibilities
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 Teaching and Learning
• Deliver high-quality, competency-based Information Technology programmes in Networking and Cyber Security, aligned with approved curricula and industry standards.
• Design and deliver student-centered, competency-based, and interactive lessons using modern teaching methodologies and educational technologies.
• Develop lesson plans, practical exercises, assessments, learning resources, and instructional materials that meet SPCE academic and quality assurance standards.
• Foster an inclusive and engaging learning environment that promotes digital literacy, problem-solving, critical thinking, teamwork, and practical technical skills.
• Conduct placement tests, midterm examinations, final examinations, practical assessments, and continuous student evaluations.
• Monitor student attendance, academic progress, learning outcomes, and classroom performance, providing academic guidance and timely interventions where required.
• Review and continuously improve course content, instructional materials, and delivery methods based on student feedback and programme evaluations.
• Deliver classroom instruction for no more than 20 academic hours per week, with the total annual teaching workload not exceeding 800 academic hours, in accordance with SPCE-UCA academic workload policy.
• Ensure the delivery of high-quality, learner-centered instruction by applying competency-based and interactive teaching methodologies, with the overall failure rate not exceeding 5% and the learner dropout rate not exceeding 6%, while upholding SPCE-UCA's academic quality standards.
 Programme Administration and Academic Support
• Develop, review, and update the programme Concept Note (CN), curriculum, course syllabi, lesson plans, and instructional materials considering the educational market requirements in coordination with the Learning Centre (LC) Coordinator and the Manager of Academic Affairs (MAA).
• Support student recruitment, application, registration, placement testing, and orientation for Information Technology programmes.
• Coordinate teaching schedules in consultation with the Students Services Officer and Learning Centre (LC) Coordinator.
• Prepare and maintain accurate academic records, including attendance, lesson plans, individual work plans, transcripts, grade reports, timetables, and other required documentation.
• Coordinate communication and follow-up with graduates and alumni of IT.
• Complete administrative, academic planning, learner support, office hours, and other assigned responsibilities for no more than 20 hours per week.
 IT Technical Support and Laboratory Management
• Develop and deliver theoretical and practical training in network fundamentals, network access, IP connectivity, IP services, network security, automation, and enterprise networking aligned with networking programme domains.
• Design and deliver practical laboratory sessions, simulations, configuration exercises, troubleshooting scenarios, and real-world networking projects covering routing, switching, small- and medium-sized network infrastructure, virtualization, and network assurance.
• Train learners in small- and medium-sized network architecture, high availability, redundancy, network virtualization, network monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
• Develop learner competency in network security, device hardening, access control, AAA, security monitoring, threat mitigation, and secure network implementation.
• Introduce network automation and programmability, including APIs, JSON, controller-based networking, SDN, and emerging AI-enabled networking technologies.
• Develop and administer quizzes, practical assessments, assignments, projects, and examinations to evaluate learners’ technical competencies.
• Provide technical guidance and mentoring to learners preparing for networking and cybersecurity certifications.
• Prepare and regularly update training materials, laboratory manuals, presentations, and practical resources in accordance with current technologies, certification domains, and professional standards.
• Conduct at least one formal classroom observation per month, resulting in a minimum of 12 documented classroom observations annually, and implement recommendations for continuous instructional improvement.
 Professional Development and Institutional Responsibilities
• Maintain the highest standards of professionalism, integrity, confidentiality, and ethical conduct.
• Participate actively in staff meetings, institutional events, professional development activities, and quality improvement initiatives.
• Perform all duties in compliance with SPCE-UCA and AKF policies, procedures, the Code of Conduct, and the Child Safeguarding Policy, and undertake any other duties assigned by the supervisor.
• To carry out responsibilities of the role in a way which reflects AKF’s commitment to protecting children and vulnerable adults in accordance with the Safeguarding Policy and Child Safeguarding Policy.
• To report any suspicions or actual violations of the Safeguarding Policy and and/or Child Safeguarding Policy as per the given training.
OCCASIONAL SIGNIFICANT DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Any tasks assigned by the immediate supervisor.
DECISION-MAKING & AUTHORITY
• N/A

Job Requirements
JOB SPECIFICATION
• Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, specializing in Networking or Cyber Security.
• Professional certifications such as CompTIA Network+, CCNA, CompTIA Security+, CEH, or other recognized networking and cybersecurity certifications are desirable.
• Minimum two years of teaching work experience in networking and cyber security.
• Ability to plan lessons, conduct assessments, prepare reports, and maintain academic records in accordance with SPCE-UCA academic regulations and quality assurance standards.
• Practical experience in design, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of networking infrastructure, routers and switches, wireless networks, firewalls, VPNs, network security solutions, virtualization platforms, network monitoring and analysis tools, network automation technologies, and cyber security laboratory environments is an asset.
• Fluency in Dari and/or Pashto, with a working knowledge of English.
REQUIRED CORE COMPETENCIES
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
• Highly motivated with strong organizational skills.
• High level of professionalism, integrity, and accountability.
• Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies and teaching methodologies.
• Strong instructional and facilitation skills.
• Practical demonstration and laboratory management skills.

Submission Guidelines
APPLICATION
Interested applicants should submit their CV along with a cover letter to Jobs.afghanistan@akdn.org no later than 02nd November 2026.
Important Notes:
• Please quote the Vacancy Number as the Subject of the e-mail when applying.
• No supporting documents (e.g., diplomas, recommendation letters, identification card(s), etc.) are required at this stage.
• Only short-listed candidates will be contacted for further assessment.
• Salary scale: Based on the organization’s salary scale.
The Aga Khan Foundation Afghanistan (AKF-Afg) promotes a transparent and equitable recruitment process. We reiterate that all services related to job applications, including processing, seminars, and training programs, are provided free of charge.
Our official job announcements are posted on the ACBAR website (acbar.org/jobs). Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their applications through our designated email address: jobs.afghanistan@akdn.org . Each job vacancy is assigned a unique identification number for your reference, and upon submitting your application, you will receive an automatic confirmation acknowledging its receipt immediately.
AKF- Afg recruitment and selection process reflects our commitment to equal opportunity and protecting children and at-risk adults, beneficiaries, partners, community members, and employees from safeguarding violations. AKF (Afg) participates in the Scheme for the disclosure of safeguarding-related misconduct within the humanitarian and development sector (Misconduct Disclosure Scheme). In line with this Scheme, AKF (Afg) will contact previous employers of job applicants to request information about any investigations or findings of misconduct concerning allegations of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse, and/or sexual harassment (sexual misconduct) against the applicant, during or after their employment. AKF (Afg) further implements a range of procedures and vetting checks, including criminal records disclosures, to ensure everyone associated with AKF (Afg) is kept free from harm and abuse is prevented.
Protection from Sexual Exploitation Abuse and Harassment (PSEAH) is the responsibility of everyone, and all selected individuals will be required to always comply with AKF (Afg)s Safeguarding Policy.
By submitting the job application, the applicant confirms to have understood and consented to AKF (Afg) contacting the applicant’s prior employers, during AKF (Afg)’s recruitment process, to request any such information and maintain this information on file for Recruitment and Human Resources Management purposes.
Female candidates are highly encouraged to apply for this position.

title: Electrical & Solar Systems Engineer
application_subject: Application for Electrical & Solar Systems Engineer – Vacancy No. 2026-02
description:
Job Summary
The Electrical & Solar Systems Engineer will be responsible for the design, installation, supervision, testing, commissioning, and maintenance of electrical and solar PV systems. The position will ensure that all electrical and solar works are implemented according to approved designs, technical specifications, safety standards, and project requirements. The engineer will also follow up, monitor, and inspect project sites and ongoing works , supervise technical teams, conduct site inspections, prepare technical documentation, and provide technical support to project teams.

Job Requirements
Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
Minimum 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in electrical systems and Solar PV systems.
Strong practical knowledge of Solar PV system design, installation, testing, commissioning, and maintenance.
Good knowledge of solar panels, inverters, batteries, charge controllers, protection systems, and electrical distribution systems.
Experience with grid-connected, off-grid, and hybrid solar systems.
Ability to prepare and review electrical and solar system designs, single-line diagrams (SLD), BOQs, technical specifications, and calculations.
Knowledge of electrical safety standards, earthing/grounding, protection, cable sizing, and electrical equipment selection.
Ability to conduct site surveys, system assessments, troubleshooting, and technical inspections.
Familiarity with AutoCAD and relevant electrical/solar design software is an advantage.
Ability to supervise technicians, subcontractors, and installation teams.
Good report writing, documentation, communication, and coordination skills.
Ability to work under pressure and travel to project sites/provinces when required.
Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office.

Submission Guideline
Interested candidates are requested to submit their updated CV and a copy of their University Degree Certificate/Diploma to the following email address:
Email: info@waheedzia.com
Subject: Application for Electrical & Solar Systems Engineer – Vacancy No. 2026-02
Deadline: 05 November 2026
Note: The University Degree Certificate/Diploma is mandatory . Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Capacity Strengthening Specialist
salary: Salary and conditions are according to ACBAR’s salary scale.
description:
Job Summary
RESPONSIBILITY SUMMARY
ACBAR is hiring a Capacity Strengthening (CS) Specialist to provide direct technical support to national and local NGO’s who request services from ACBAR’s Capacity Strengthening Support Services Team. The CS Specialist will develop tailored support plans to assist NGOs to make improvements based upon specific organizational needs and goals. The CS Specialist will be responsible to work with the NGO’s assigned to their case load, ensuring that they meet the goals of their support plan, demonstrate tangible improvements, make correction as needed when goals are not being met, and conduct follow up assessments to determine how well the capacity support program has been adopted and implemented by the organization.
ACBAR will hire the CS Specialist based upon four key categories of services we will offer to NGOs:
Program Development and Acquisition: The CS Specialist will support NGOs to improve their ability to design and develop new programs, as well as supporting their capacity to write new concept notes and proposals, develop proposal submissions, and engage with donors and funders.
Program Management and Field-Level Implementation: The CS Specialist will support NGOs to improve the implementation of their programs, including developing and following work plans, supporting their ability to technically implement programs in the field, manage budgets, conducting regular monitoring, and provide timely reporting concerning their programs.
Organizational and Operational Capacity: The CS Specialist will support organizations to improve their internal capacity, reviewing and improving current policies, procedures and structure to ensure their organization meets basic practices for operational performance in finance, HR, procurement, logistics, IT/data management, and other key operational areas.
Accountability and Inclusion: The CS Specialist will support organizations to assess how their programs can better reflect the needs of the communities in which the work, particularly for affected populations, and to develop plans to improve how their activities can reach a greater number of people based on their needs.
ESSENTIAL TASKS AND DELIVERABLES
The CS Specialist will be required to fulfill the following tasks:
Develop capacity strengthening support plans for assigned NGO’s who are part of their case load, assessing what needs the organization has based upon specific goals or identified gaps articulated by the organization.
Provide direct mentoring support to national and local NGO’s who request specific capacity strengthening support from ACBAR based upon the agreed upon support plan.
Support the development and implementation of monitoring and assessment tools, as well as programmatic follow-up mechanisms, to assess the impact of project activities.
Working closely with the MEAL team, conduct regular follow up and monitoring visits and engagement with NGOs to gauge the progress of implementing their support plans and to assess the impact of services offered.
Travel to regional offices to support on capacity strengthening service delivery to local NGO’s not based in Kabul based upon the assigned caseload.
Support the development of written reports, success stories and social media pieces that will provide timely updates to ACBAR members, donors, partners and the public on the effectiveness of the services provided.
As requested, support training department activities at the national and sub-national level to ensure integration between capacity strengthening activities and the technical trainings provided to NGO staff members.
Support any other tasks assigned by the direct line manager or the Head of Programs to support the successful implementation of capacity strengthening activities within the program.

Job Requirements
Bachelor’s degree from an accredited academic institution, preferably in humanitarian or development studies, training/education, and/or management or business, Master’s Degree preferred.
Minimum of seven years of progressively responsible experience leading and managing humanitarian or development programs with an international or national NGO. Specific expertise may be either in program implementation or program administration/operations.
The Capacity Strengthening Specialist shall possess demonstrated expertise in data management, digital transformation, and the development of Management Information Systems (MIS) for organizational functions, including Human Resources, Procurement, Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E), and general operations. The Specialist must be highly proficient in the use of Microsoft Excel and Access, including database development, automation, dashboards, reporting, and data analysis, and have proven experience utilizing and recommending appropriate free and premium online platforms, portals, applications, and digital tools to improve organizational efficiency, data quality, reporting, decision-making, and institutional performance.
Specific Experience on at least one of the following:
Program Development and Acquisition: Minimum five years of experience developing new humanitarian and development programs, including experience writing new grant proposals and concept notes, developing key program documents for new programs, and proven experience working and engaging with institutional donors, the UN and other funding sources.
Program Management and Implementation: Minimum five years of experience managing projects at the field level, with proven success at completing project work plans, delivering sound and quality programs with community support, managing administrative requirements of grant implementation, and demonstrated experience monitoring, evaluating and reporting on program implementation.
Organizational and Operational Capacity: Minimum five years of experience managing the internal operational departments of an NGO, with a background including previous work in finance, procurement, administration, etc., with experience in a senior management role preferred. Additionally, the applicant should demonstrate proven experience developing quality internal procedures and policies of an NGO.
Accountability and Inclusion: Minimum five years of experience leading accountability and inclusion for women, girls, people with disability and affected populations within NGO programs, as well as proven experience provide direct supporting engaging community leaders and other community stakeholders for successful program implementation. Knowledge of AAP best practices is preferred.
OTHER REQUIRED SKILLS:
Excellent writing and verbal skills in English, as well as in either Dari or Pashto.
Demonstrated experience supporting national or local NGO partners to improve their capacity through your experience working for NGOs in a specific specialty.
Proven experience developing program documents, operating procedures and manuals, work plans, progress reports, etc. necessary to successfully implement ongoing programs.
Demonstrated ability to be a self-starter and ability to independently manage tasks.
Demonstrated to commitment to accountability, equity and inclusion in leading project teams and program implementation.
Ability and commitment to work well within a team, and willingness to provide support for tasks of other team members that may not fall directly within your job

Submission Guideline
If you possess the necessary qualifications and experience, we invite you to complete the form using the link provided below by November. 03, 2026. Prepare your CV and cover letter as a single file before applying; you will have to attach them.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Notes:
Please be informed that the written test and interview will be conducted only in person.
Job Application Form Link : https://form.acbar.org/app/form?id=RuBNfQ

title: متخصص ارشد نرم افزار
description:
Role Summary
هدف وظیفه :
تحلیل، طراحی، ایجاد، توسعه، آزمایش، استقرار و نگهداری سیستم های معلوماتی تحت ویب و مبایل اپلیکیشن، و مدیریت تیم توسعه نرم‌ افزار و پروژه‌ ها از مرحله تحلیل نیازمندی ‌ها تا بهره ‌برداری نهایی به منظور دیجیتلی‌ سازی خدمات و بهبود موثریت کاری اداره مرکزی و شاروالی ها.

Duties and Responsibilities
وظایف و مسئولیت ها:
وظایف اساسی:.
• تحلیل نیازمندی و طراحی‌ و توسعه سیستم‌ های معلوماتی مطابق معیار های ملی و بین ‌المللی.
• ایجاد، توسعه، نگهداری سیستم ‌های معلوماتی تحت وب (Web Applications).
• ایجاد، توسعه، نگهداری اپلیکیشن‌ های موبایل (Mobile Applications).
• طراحی و توسعه API ها و Web Services جهت ارتباط میان سیستم ‌ها.
• طراحی و توسعه دیتابیس ها و ساختار دیتابیس.
• رفع خطاها و مشکلات نرم‌ افزاری و ارائه راهکار های مناسب.
• انجام Unit Testing، Integration Testing ، System Testing ، User Acceptance Testing (UAT) ،
Performance Testing ، Security Testing و رفع آسیب ‌پذیری ‌های نرم‌ افزاری.
• پیشبرد امور (Git) و رعایت اصول Source Control.
• استقرار (deployment) نرم ‌افزار ها در محیط‌ های Test و Production.
• پیشبرد امور CI/CD و DevOps Processes.
• تهیه و نگهداری مستندات تخنیکی نرم‌افزارها.
• رعایت اصول Secure Coding و Software Development Standards.
• نظارت بر عملکرد سیستم ‌ها و بهینه ‌سازی سرعت و کارایی آن‌ ها.
• تحلیل و رفع مشکلات پیچیده نرم ‌افزار ها و دیتابیس ها.
• طراحی و تطبیق مکانیزم‌ های امنیتی در سیستم‌ های معلوماتی.
• ارائه پیشنهادات تخنیکی برای بهبود سیستم‌های موجود.
• همکاری تخنیکی با بخش شبکه، سرورها، امنیت سایبری و دیتاسنتر در راستای بهره ‌برداری بهتر سیستم ‌ها.
• ارائه مشوره‌ های تخصصی تخنیکی به مدیریت در بخش توسعه سیستم‌ ها و تحول دیجیتلی.
• نظارت بر تمامی پروژه ‌های نرم ‌افزاری و اطمینان از تکمیل آن ‌ها مطابق زمان بندی تعیین شده.
• انجام سایر وظایف مرتبط تخنیکی مطابق هدایت آمر ذیصلاح.
وظایف مدیریتی:
• تشخیص نیاز های آموزشی و ارتقای ظرفیت تیم تخنیکی
• ترتیب، تطبیق و بهبود طرزالعمل‌ها، رهنمود ها و استندرد های توسعه نرم‌افزار.
• مدیریت پروژه‌ های نرم ‌افزاری از مرحله تحلیل الی بهره ‌برداری.
• ترتیب گزارش‌های تخنیکی و مدیریتی و ارائه آن به رئیس مربوطه.
وظایف هماهنگی:
• هماهنگی با تیم توسعه نرم‌ افزار جهت پیشبرد پروژه ‌ها.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Role Summary
Prak Net is a new internet provider for homes and businesses in Afghanistan, sold and managed through the Reab app. Customers and their families, many living abroad, order, pay for and manage their internet from their phones, so the network behind it has to be fast, stable and well documented. You will build that network with your own hands: tower and rooftop wireless links, fibre connections in parts of Kabul where fibre is already in the ground, MikroTik routing at the core, and TP-Link routers in customers’ homes. You will connect new areas in Kabul and the provinces, and help switch customers who already use fibre from other providers over to Prak Net. We are hiring two engineers. The more experienced one joins as Senior Network Engineer and leads the technical work and planning; the second joins as Network Engineer and works alongside them in the field. Both are hands-on roles.

Duties and Responsibilities
Wireless and towers
Survey sites and plan coverage for new areas, including line of sight and tower or rooftop options.
Install towers, masts and rooftop sites: mount antennas and radios, run and protect cables, ground and secure equipment.
Build and align point-to-point backbone links and point-to-multipoint links to customers.
Plan frequencies, reduce interference and keep link quality high as the network grows.
Fibre
Connect Prak Net to fibre networks in Kabul, including fibre leased or shared from other providers.
Plan and build fibre-to-the-home (FTTH/GPON): OLT, splitters, distribution boxes and ONT installation at customers’ homes.
Splice, terminate and test fibre with OTDR and power meters; find and repair breaks quickly.
Move customers from other providers’ fibre to Prak Net with minimal downtime, including ONT and router swaps.
Keep a clear map of every fibre route, splice point, splitter and customer port.
Core network and MikroTik
Configure and run MikroTik routers: routing (OSPF, BGP basics), PPPoE, VLANs, speed queues, firewall and failover.
Connect upstream bandwidth and set up backup links so customers stay online if one link fails.
Set up speed plans, night speeds, data limits and suspensions with the RADIUS and billing system.
Plan IP addressing and keep the network secure: strong passwords, restricted management access, regular updates.
Customer installations
Install and configure TP-Link routers at homes and businesses, set up Wi-Fi and test speed before leaving.
Connect routers to the remote management platform so customers can change Wi-Fi, see devices and restart from the app.
Explain the service clearly and politely to customers and their families.
Monitoring, faults and outages
Monitor links, towers and routers and act on alerts before customers notice.
Restore service fast during outages, then write a short report on the cause and the fix.
Reduce repeat faults by fixing root causes, not just symptoms.
Records, stock and reporting
Document sites, links, IP plans and device settings, with passwords stored securely.
Track stock of routers, radios, fibre, cables and spare parts.
Work with the software team so speed boosts, Wi-Fi controls and outage alerts work end to end in the app.
Send the founders a weekly report: work done, new installations, open faults, capacity and what is needed.
Extra for the Senior Network Engineer
Design the overall network and plan expansion area by area, with costs.
Lead and train the Network Engineer and any technicians we add; set safety rules for tower and rooftop work.
Choose equipment and suppliers with the Operations Manager.

Job Requirements
What you need
Network Engineer: 3+ years installing and running ISP or wireless ISP networks.
Senior Network Engineer: 5+ years, including designing networks and leading technicians.
Strong MikroTik skills; MTCNA preferred (required for the senior role), MTCRE or MTCINE a plus.
Hands-on wireless experience (e.g. Ubiquiti, Cambium, MikroTik radios): alignment, frequency planning, link budgets.
Hands-on fibre experience: splicing, OTDR testing, and GPON/FTTH (OLT, ONT, splitters).
Experience installing and configuring TP-Link or similar customer routers.
Working knowledge of IP addressing, VLANs, DHCP, PPPoE and basic routing.
Comfortable working at height on towers and rooftops, following safety rules.
Willing to travel to provinces, sometimes for several days.
Fluent Dari or Pashto; basic English for reports and equipment manuals.
Nice to have
Experience moving customers between providers on shared or leased fibre.
Experience with RADIUS or an ISP billing platform (Splynx, ISPbox or similar).
Experience with TP-Link Aginet or other remote router management (TR-069).
Network monitoring tools such as Zabbix, LibreNMS or The Dude.
A driving licence.
Your first 90 days
First month : learn our setup, audit existing equipment and links, and fix any urgent risks.
Second month : bring the first areas live (wireless and fibre) and complete the first customer installations.
Third month : start switching fibre customers from other providers, set up monitoring and finish the network documentation.
How we will measure success
Network uptime and how quickly faults are fixed.
Sites, links and fibre connections built on schedule and working reliably.
Installations and customer switch-overs completed on the booked day.
Fewer repeat faults each month.
Clear, up-to-date records of the network that anyone on the team can follow.

Submission Guidelines

Kindly Share and rename your CV along with short note with your full name before submitting it.

Only short-listed candidates will be called for a written test and subsequent interview.
Tests and Interview will be conducted on a rolling basis.

title: Manager Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) & Internal Controls Oversight
category: Information Technology, Accounting, Finance, Telecommunication, Business Administration, Risk Management
description:
Role Summary
To lead the establishment, maintenance, and continuous enhancement of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Framework across Etisalat Afghanistan by providing independent risk oversight, challenge, monitoring, reporting, and advisory support to promote effective management of risks within the approved risk appetite. The role serves as a second-line risk oversight function, promoting a strong risk culture and informed decision-making. In addition, the role provides independent oversight of the Internal Controls Framework and coordinates and monitors risk-based control review, testing, and remediation activities in alignment with Etisalat Group requirements.

Duties and Responsibilities
• Lead and coordinate enterprise-wide risk identification, assessment, evaluation, monitoring, and reporting activities covering strategic, operational, financial, regulatory, compliance, fraud, cybersecurity, technology, business continuity, and reputational risks.
• Facilitate periodic risk assessments and Risk C Control Self-Assessments (RCSA) across business functions to identify emerging risks, assess control effectiveness, and evaluate residual risk exposure.
• Maintain the Enterprise Risk Register, ensuring significant risks are appropriately documented, assessed, assigned to risk owners, and supported by mitigation plans.
• Develop, maintain, and monitor risk appetite statements, risk tolerance thresholds, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and Key Control Indicators (KCIs), and escalate significant breaches and exposures to management.
• Facilitate and oversee the documentation and periodic review of risks, controls, control ownership, testing procedures, and remediation plans for critical business processes.
• Coordinate and oversee the annual Internal Controls Review and Testing Program to assess the design adequacy and operating effectiveness of key controls.
• Identify control deficiencies, process weaknesses, and governance gaps through risk and control assessments, and provide independent recommendations to management to strengthen the effectiveness of the control environment.
• Monitor and report the implementation status of risk mitigation actions, control remediation plans, and risk-related recommendations arising from Internal Audit, External Audit, regulatory reviews, and management assessments.
• Prepare and present periodic risk and internal control reports to the VP Risk C Assurance, Executive Risk Management Committee (ERMC), and the Audit C Risk Management Committee (ARMC), highlighting key risk exposures, emerging risks, control weaknesses, trends, and mitigation progress.
• Collaborate with Internal Audit, Compliance, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, Information Security, Finance, Technology, Human Resources, and business functions to enhance enterprise-wide risk and control management practices.
• Act as Secretary to the Executive Risk Management Committee (ERMC) chaired by the CEO by coordinating meetings, preparing agendas and risk reports, recording minutes, tracking action items, and facilitating timely closure of agreed actions.
• Assess and monitor regulatory and compliance risks and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to support adherence to telecommunications regulations, license obligations, corporate policies, and applicable laws.
• Provide independent oversight of Business Continuity Management (BCM) and Disaster Recovery (DR) testing exercises and monitor implementation of agreed improvement actions.
• Evaluate cybersecurity, information security, data privacy, technology, and network resilience risks in collaboration with relevant stakeholders and ensure such risks are appropriately reflected in the Enterprise Risk Register.
• Provide risk advisory support for strategic initiatives, major projects, investments, new products, digital transformation programs, outsourcing arrangements, and other significant business decisions.
• Promote a strong risk-aware and control-conscious culture through communication, training, awareness initiatives, and stakeholder engagement activities.
• Monitor industry trends, emerging risks, geopolitical developments, regulatory changes, and market conditions that may impact Etisalat Afghanistan's objectives and operations.

Job Requirements
Educational Qualifications:
• Bachelor's Degree in Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Telecommunications and Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Preferred:
• Master’s degree in risk management
• Certified Risk Management Professional (CRMP)
• Certification in Risk Management Assurance (CRMA)
• Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
• Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
• Financial Risk Manager (FRM)
• ISO 31000 Risk Management Certification
Experience Requirements:
• Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Controls, Compliance, Governance, Risk Advisory, or related disciplines.
• Substantial hands-on experience in Enterprise Risk Management is essential. Experience in Internal Controls, Internal Audit, Compliance, Governance, or Assurance may be considered as complementary experience.
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in a managerial or leadership role - preferred.
• Experience within telecommunications, technology, financial services, or other highly regulated industries is preferred.
• Demonstrated experience in implementing and maintaining Enterprise Risk Management and Internal Control Frameworks.
• Experience in facilitating senior management and Board-level committees and preparing executive and Board reports.
• Strong understanding of risk management frameworks, internal controls, governance, regulatory compliance, business continuity, and operational resilience.
Technical Competencies:
• Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
• Internal Control Frameworks (COSO)
• ISO 31000 Risk Management
• Governance, Risk C Compliance (GRC)
• Risk Assessment and Analysis
• Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSA)

description:
DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS
5 November 2026-23:59-GMT+04:30 Afghanistan Time (Kabul)
WFP celebrates and embraces diversity. It is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all its employees and encourages qualified candidates to apply irrespective of race, colour, national origin, ethnic or social background, genetic information, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, HIV status or disability.
ABOUT WFP
The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of extreme weather shocks.
At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.
To learn more about WFP, visit our website: https://www.wfp.org and follow us on social media to keep up with our latest news: YouTube , LinkedIn , Instagram , Facebook , Twitter , TikTok .
WHY JOIN WFP?
WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.
WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.
WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.
A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.
We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement).
BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT:
The World Food Programme (WFP) is the world's largest humanitarian agency, fighting hunger worldwide. Over the years, WFP has made available its supply chain expertise, knowledge and network to governments, donors and UN agencies as a global good. The Data Scientist position will contribute to strengthening the evidence agenda of the Country Office through innovative analysis, including the development and training of artificial intelligence models tailored to food security and vulnerability, thereby enhancing the efficiency of VAM analysis and enabling more precise programme design and targeting
ACCOUNTABILITIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:
Under the direct supervision of the Head of VAME the consultant is responsible for:
 In collaboration with VAME GIS officer, Support the periodic updates, maintenance of the VAME geospatial visualization platform (AF Pulse), which integrates data from programme, assessment, monitoring, security, operations and supply chain with data collection, standardization and upload;
 Design, calibrate, and operationalize a probability model that estimates the likelihood of road disruption in proximity to conflict events.
 Update, validate, calibrate and operationalize a probability model that estimates acute malnutrition levels using acute malnutrition admission data and other related variables.
 Intergrade automated models into AF Pulse to strengthen the real-time disaster impacts and exposure analysis.
 Propose a replication and scale‑up roadmap, documenting migration pathways to alternative cloud environments, producing an open‑source replication toolkit, and identifying priority countries for adaptation of the model.
 Develop, test and refine geographical-level targeting criteria and models for emergency assistance, resilience, livelihoods and social protection interventions and geographical and beneficiary targeting to ensure maximum efficiency and equity in resource allocation, minimizing geographical bias.
 Coordinate and provide technical analysis, recommendations and learnings to continuously improve the early warning workstream.
 Other tasks as required by the VAME related to Early Warning Analysis and Systems.
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in social science, economics, statistics, food security, GIS, data science, or other relevant subjects. Master’s degree would be an advantage.
Experience:
Minimum 3 years of experience in research, data analysis, modelling including AI model training, needs assessments, and/or data and geo-spatial visualization.
Knowledge & Skills:
• Experience with the implementation and administration of SQL databases using tools such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc;
• Proven skills in advanced skills in managing geospatial information platforms as well as online publishing (e.g., Tableau, Power BI);
• Proven skills in authoring and developing analytical products, such as reports or infographics; Ability to tailor such products to a variety of stakeholders;
• Ability to engage audiences in data-driven discussions;
• Strong client orientation and ability to communicate and present abstract subject matter to wide audiences;
• Strong sense of purpose and eagerness to make one’s contribution count, while listening carefully to clients;
• Ability to coach staff and accompany their professional development;
• Proven skills and experience in planning and facilitating training.
Languages:
Fluency (level C) in English. Additional UN language proficiency is desirable.
Languages:
Fluency (level C) in English. Additional UN language proficiency is desirable.
TYPE OF CONTRACT: International Consultant Level I
UNIT/DIVISION: Programme
DUTY STATION (City, Country): Kabul, Afghanistan

WFP Leadership Framework guides to the common standards of behavior that guide HOW we work together to accomplish our mission.

WFP is committed to supporting individuals with disabilities by providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please contact: global.inclusion@wfp.org
NO FEE DISCLAIMER
The United Nations does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process. Should you receive a solicitation for the payment of a fee, please disregard it. Furthermore, please note that emblems, logos, names and addresses are easily copied and reproduced. Therefore, you are advised to apply particular care when submitting personal information on the web.
REMINDERS BEFORE YOU SUBMIT YOUR APPLICATION
All applications must be submitted exclusively through our online recruiting system. We do not consider CVs or applications sent by email, LinkedIn, or any other channel.
We strongly recommend that your Workday profile is accurate and complete, and that all sections are filled in, including your employment history, academic qualifications, language skills, and UN grade (if applicable). Once your profile is completed, please apply, and submit your application.
If you experience technical issues while submitting your application, you may contact us at global.hrerecruitment@wfp.org . Please note that this email is only for technical issues with an application - unsolicited applications or documents sent to this inbox will not receive a reply .
At the application stage, the only required documents are your CV and Cover Letter. Additional documents (passport, certificates, recommendation letters, etc.) may be requested later in the process.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and invited to proceed to the next stage of the recruitment process.
All employment decisions are made on the basis of organizational needs, job requirements, merit, and individual qualifications. WFP is committed to providing an inclusive work environment free of sexual exploitation and abuse, all forms of discrimination, any kind of harassment, sexual harassment, and abuse of authority. Therefore, all selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference and background checks.
No appointment under any kind of contract will be offered to members of the UN Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions (ACABQ), International Civil Service Commission (ICSC), FAO Finance Committee, WFP External Auditor, WFP Audit Committee, Joint Inspection Unit (JIU) and other similar bodies within the United Nations system with oversight responsibilities over WFP, both during their service and within three years of ceasing that service.

application_subject: [Re-announced] Engineer - IT Data Center (Microsoft & Servers Infrastructure) (Mazar)
description:
Role Summary
Responsible for the operation, administration, security, availability and continuous improvement of ATOMA Microsoft infrastructure, with primary ownership of Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra services, SCCM/WSUS and related enterprise Microsoft platforms. The position also provides cross-platform support for VMware, Linux, enterprise storage, backup, physical server hardware, monitoring and Disaster Recovery to ensure reliable Data Center services across Primary and DR sites.

Duties and Responsibilities
· Administer and maintain Windows Server infrastructure and related Microsoft services across Primary and Disaster Recovery Data Centers.
· Administer Active Directory Domain Services, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, LDAP integrations, identity services, trusts, replication and domain health.
· Administer Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Entra ID, authentication, mail flow, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint and tenant-level operational support within approved responsibilities.
· Support Azure services and Microsoft Entra integrations used by ATOMA, including identity synchronization, role-based access and hybrid identity components.
· Administer SCCM/Microsoft Configuration Manager, WSUS, patch management, software deployment, inventory and compliance reporting for Windows servers and approved endpoints.
· Administer Windows infrastructure services including RDS, IIS, DFS/File Services, PKI/Certificate Services, SMTP and related Microsoft server roles.
· Support on-premises Exchange/SMTP services and hybrid mail dependencies where applicable, including troubleshooting of mail flow and certificate-related issues.
· Use PowerShell and approved automation methods to standardize administration, reporting, health checks, user/service operations and repetitive support activities.
· Monitor Microsoft platform availability, capacity, performance, event logs, replication, service health and security status; take corrective action before business impact occurs.
· Implement approved Microsoft security baselines, hardening standards, privileged access controls, patching and remediation actions in coordination with Information Security.
· Manage Microsoft-related SSL/TLS certificates, PKI dependencies, service certificates and renewal/deployment activities in coordination with application and security teams.
· Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 support for major Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra, SCCM and identity incidents; perform root-cause analysis and preventive actions.
· Administer and support Veeam Backup and Recovery for Windows Server, Active Directory and other Microsoft workloads, including backup jobs, repositories, schedules, retention, monitoring, troubleshooting and restore operations.
· Perform regular backup and restore validation using Veeam and Veritas NetBackup to ensure recoverability of Microsoft infrastructure services.
· Administer and support enterprise Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions, including PAM360 or equivalent platforms, for secure administrative access to Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft infrastructure and Data Center systems.
· Manage privileged accounts, password vaulting, administrative access policies, session controls and privileged-access audit logs.
· Support Microsoft DNS integration with Pi-hole DNS infrastructure, including conditional forwarding, upstream DNS configuration, name-resolution troubleshooting and coordination with the Linux infrastructure engineer.
· Support VMware vSphere/ESXi/vCenter operations, virtual machine provisioning and troubleshooting as a secondary responsibility and provide cross-coverage to the virtualization team.
· Provide operational support for enterprise Linux servers, storage platforms, backup jobs and Data Center server hardware when required for incident recovery or cross-team coverage.
· Support Dell, HPE and Huawei server platforms, including hardware health monitoring, firmware/driver coordination, warranty troubleshooting and vendor escalation.
· Participate in backup and restore validation using enterprise backup platforms, and ensure Microsoft workloads are protected according to approved backup and retention requirements.
· Participate in Disaster Recovery planning, testing and recovery of Windows, identity, Microsoft 365 integration and supporting infrastructure services.
· Maintain accurate system documentation, build standards, configuration records, architecture diagrams, operational procedures and knowledge-base articles.
· Follow ITIL-aligned incident, problem and change management processes and ensure assigned tickets, changes and actions are documented and closed within agreed service levels.
· Provide 24x7/on-call support when required for critical Microsoft infrastructure incidents, maintenance activities or Data Center/DR operations.

Job Requirements
Education:
· Education: Bachelor's degree (BCS) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering or a related field from a reputable university of Afghanistan or abroad.
Experience:
· Minimum 8+ years of relevant experience in Enterprise Infrastructure and Data Center Operations, including hands-on experience in a telecommunications company or telecom service-provider environment. Strong practical experience in Microsoft Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra, SCCM/WSUS and enterprise Microsoft services is required. Experience with VMware, Linux, enterprise storage, backup and server hardware is required for cross-platform support. Experience in supporting 24x7 mission-critical infrastructure and Disaster Recovery operations is required.
Training & Preferred Certifications:
· MCSE / Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (legacy) or current Microsoft Windows Server / Windows Server Hybrid administration certification
· MCP / Microsoft Certified Professional (legacy) or equivalent Microsoft role-based certification
· Microsoft 365 administration certification (Microsoft 365 Certified or equivalent)
· Microsoft Azure Administrator / Azure Fundamentals or equivalent Azure certification
· Microsoft Security, Identity or Entra-related certification is an advantage
· VMware VCP, Linux administration, ITIL Foundation or fundamental networking certification is an advantage

Submission Guidelines
Interested Afghan nationals can send their applications and resumes (with three valid references) by Nov 06, 2026 .
Please mention the name of the position / Reference # in your e-mail subject line.
Only the applications received from the individuals residing in the mentioned province who meet the requirements will be considered.
Applications received after the deadline and those that do not meet the requirements mentioned above will not be considered.

title: Internal Audit Senior Officer (IT)
description:
Role Summary
The Internal Audit Senior Officer (IT) is responsible for conducting internal audits and pre-audit compliance reviews to ensure compliance with organizational policies, procedures, applicable laws, and internal control systems. The incumbent initiates, designs, and develops internal audit programs aimed at protecting the company’s assets and resources. He/she is responsible for the investigation of irregularities and recommends improvements to practices, structures, and procedures.

Duties and Responsibilities
Assist in developing and executing the annual internal audit plan and assess compliance with AWCC policies and procedures and management directives.
Conduct risk-based IT audits.
Review and assess IT systems, infrastructure, and applications.
Evaluate internal controls over Access Management, Cybersecurity, System changes, backup, and disaster recovery.
Evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls and risk management processes.
Identify weaknesses and recommend corrective actions.
Prepare audit working papers and draft audit reports.
Follow up on implementation of audit recommendations.
Assist in identifying operational, financial, and IT-related risks.
Ensure proper documentation and filing of audit evidence.
Participate in stock counts and asset verification.
Review payment vouchers, purchase orders, contracts, and other transactions before approval.
Verify accuracy, completeness, authorization, and supporting documentation.
Ensure compliance with procurement policies and delegation of authority.
Identify and prevent potential irregularities before transactions are finalized.
Recommend correction or rejection of non-compliant transactions.
Ensure that the requested costs are in accordance with audit/procurement policy and do not exceed the normal market rate.

Job Requirements
Bachelor's degree in computer science; a Master's degree is preferable. (CCNA certificate is an asset)
Good knowledge of telecommunications laws, rules, and regulations.
At least 3-4 years of related experience in the Audit & IT Department.
Fluent communication skills (written and verbal) in local languages as well as English.
Professional training or certificates in IT & Audit-related fields are a plus.
Understanding of multiple technology domains, including software development, Windows, Database Management, and Networking.
Capable of working independently and with minimal supervision.
Able to travel to all provinces of Afghanistan.
Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills; ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
Expert knowledge of internal auditing, internal controls, and risk management.
Comprehensive understanding of internal control environments within the IT function.
Excellent leadership and teamwork skills.
Proactive, hands-on, results-driven orientation required.

description:
Role Summary
Provide senior-level technical expertise in applied research, engineering assessment and development of practical solutions for DABS power generation, transmission and distribution systems. The position identifies opportunities to improve network reliability, operational efficiency, safety and technology adoption, and translates research findings into technically justified recommendations for management and relevant operational departments

Duties and Responsibilities
Power Systems Research and Engineering Analysis
Conduct applied technical studies on electricity generation, transmission, distribution and grid integration, prioritizing operational needs identified by DABS
Analyze network performance, technical losses, reliability, power quality, equipment performance and system constraints; identify feasible improvement measures
Evaluate relevant engineering designs, technical specifications, study reports and proposed technologies, and provide evidence-based technical opinions within the assigned mandate
Use appropriate engineering calculations, modelling and simulation tools to assess alternatives, document assumptions and validate study results
Technology Development and Innovation
Assess emerging technologies, including grid automation, SCADA applications, smart-grid solutions, energy storage and renewable-energy integration, for their technical suitability and implementation feasibility
Identify opportunities to improve the design, specification, testing, maintenance and, where relevant, local production or assembly of electrical equipment
Prepare technical concepts, pilot-study proposals, test plans and evaluation criteria for proposed innovations in coordination with responsible departments
Assess prototype or pilot results and recommend whether solutions should be refined, scaled up or discontinued
Technical Studies and Implementation Support
Prepare feasibility assessments and technical comparisons covering performance, cost implications, risks, safety, maintainability and implementation requirements
Develop study scopes, work plans, technical deliverables and progress updates for assigned research activities
Provide technical support to Operations, Planning and other relevant departments in evaluating research findings and potential field applications
Identify applicable technical standards, regulatory requirements and DABS specifications, and document compliance considerations in recommendations
Coordination, Reporting and Knowledge Transfer
Coordinate with internal technical units, equipment suppliers, research institutions and other approved partners to collect data, review findings and facilitate knowledge transfer
Prepare clear technical reports, engineering recommendations, presentations and decision-support briefs for the Director of Research and Development and senior management
Maintain organized research records, calculations, models, test evidence and lessons learned to support traceability and future use
Share technical knowledge through briefings, workshops and practical guidance to relevant DABS personnel as requested
Expected Deliverables
Approved work plans and periodic progress reports for assigned technical studies
Technical assessment reports, feasibility studies, engineering analyses and documented recommendations
Technology or pilot evaluation reports, including findings, risks and proposed next steps
Technical presentations and knowledge-sharing materials for relevant stakeholders

Job Requirements
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering
Minimum five years of relevant professional experience in power systems engineering, applied research, technical studies or technology development, preferably involving utility transmission and/or distribution systems
Strong knowledge of power-system operation, planning, reliability, protection and relevant engineering standards

title: Product Engineer (PM)
description:
Location: Fully Remote
Compensation: $23.08 to $34.62 USD/hour
Benefits: 15 days PTO. Christmas Day and New Year's Day paid off.
Fair warning: the pace is intense and the ambiguity is real. But you'll feel yourself growing every single week, even the rough ones, and you'll be doing it next to people who actually celebrate your wins and have your back.
We're the all-in-one agentic marketing platform. AI-native from day one. We're not joining a category, we're defining it.
We're looking for a Product Engineer to own a pod's output end-to-end: strategy, specs, QA, and enough technical depth to unblock engineers or write the code yourself when that's the fastest path forward. If you want real ownership, move fast, and raise the bar every week, keep reading. If you've been waiting for a PM role that doesn't ask you to leave your technical background at the door, this is it.
What you'll own
Own the roadmap for your pod: define what gets built, kill low-leverage work, and protect your engineers' time and focus
Write specs that start with the problem, not the solution, and ship every brief with a clear success criterion
Participate technically: read the codebase, debug independently, and ship small things when it's faster than context-switching an engineer
Own QA end-to-end: test plans, regression passes, release sign-off, and post-deploy monitoring in Sentry and Grafana
Keep the pod moving: fast decisions, async-first communication, and zero ambiguity about what's next
Close the feedback loop between customers, data, and product direction, and hold yourself accountable to the KPIs you define
You'll thrive here if...
You've shipped production code before and you're honest with yourself about your technical depth
You treat a spec as a hypothesis to pressure-test, not a document to execute against
You don't wait to be told what to do. You see the gap and you move.
Deadlines don't rattle you. Ambiguity doesn't either.
You're an AI power user, not someone who's "open to learning it someday."
You communicate clearly, especially when things are unclear.
You have opinions and you're not afraid to bring them.
You can laugh at a chaotic week on Friday and mean it.
What we're looking for
3+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, startup or high-growth environment
A hands-on technical background: production code, a bootcamp, or demonstrable ability to navigate a full-stack codebase
Comfortable reading Python and JavaScript/TypeScript; able to write SQL, reason about REST contracts, and follow frontend state
Proven QA ownership: test cases, regression cycles, structured bug reports, release sign-off
Daily fluency with Claude Code or equivalent. Not "open to it." Actually using it.
Strong written communication. Your specs are clear and complete on the first read.
Available in EST
What working here actually looks like
High expectations. Real ownership. Things change fast and we don't apologize for it. You'll work with smart people who push you, a product that keeps getting better, and a team that's genuinely building something new.
The boundary between product and engineering is intentionally blurred here. The best product decisions are inseparable from technical reality, and we hire people who understand that.
We'll probably give you more to own than you expected. That's on purpose.
We use AI every day, across every function. That's just how we work.
What we stand for
We are obsessed with our customers, and making them obsessed with us
We figure it the f**k out
We go to war on our problems quickly
We are strategic. We work smart, not just hard.
We're fun AF
About Search Atlas
Search Atlas helps marketing teams move faster, make smarter decisions, and do more with less. We're a $30M+ ARR company, 215 people, bootstrapped, and building the infrastructure for the next era of marketing. No outside funding. No fluff. Just product.

description:
Job Summary
هدف وظیفه: ایجاد، انکشاف، طرح و حمایت تخنیکی سیستم های الکترونیکی ضرورت وزارت مالیه

Job Requirements
وظایف و مسئولیت ها:
وظایف اساسی:
مطالعه و تدقیق پروسه های کاری غرض کد نویسي سیستم ها (دیتابیس ها) و پیشنهاد راه حل جهت رفع موانع و چالش های سیستم های متذکره.
تدوین و تطبیق طرح ها، پروسیجر های جدید کاری، طرز العمل ها و پلان عمل مطابق استراتیژی ریاست تکنالوژی معلوماتی غرض تسریع روند حکومتداری الکترونیکی و ساده سازی پروسه های کاری.
توسعه سیستم ها و ویب سایت ها با درنظر داشت پالیسی های موجود و ویژه گی های مانند: User-friendly, Clean coding, Good UI/UX, Modularity, Performance and flexibility
حصول اطمینان از رفع مشکلات تخنیکی و مصؤنیت سیستم های اداره.
حصول اطمینان از استفادۀ درست و مؤثر از سیستم الکترونیکی اداره به منظور هماهنگی، شفافیت و تسریع پروسۀ کاری و اجراآت لازم طبق هدایت آمر بخش مربوطه.
مطالعه تکنالوژی های جدید و به کار گیری از آنها غرض بروزرسانی و توسعه نرم افزارهای مورد استفاده وزارت مالیه
اشتراک در کنفرانس ها و ورکشاپ های مربوط به توسعه سیستم ها و ارتقاء ظرفیت.
ارتباط موثر با اعضای تیم و Stakeholders به صورت شفاهی و کتبی غرض بهبود امور و سیستم های موجود وزارت مالیه.
بهینه سازی عملکرد، مقیاس پذیری و کارایی نرم افزار از طریق پروفایل کد، کش کردن و سایر تکنیک های مرتبط.
نگهداری اسناد فنی جامع، از جمله معماری سیستم، مشخصات طراحی و راهنمای کاربر
بررسی کد ها و حصول اطمینان از کیفیت، امنیت و قابلیت نگهداری کد و داشتن سهم فعال در فرآیند تضمین کیفیت .
وظایف مدیریتی:
تهیه و ترتیب پلان کاری ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه در مطابقت با پلان عمومی اداره، جهت بدست آوردن اهداف تعیین شده.
ارایه گزارش ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه و عندالضرورت از فعالیت ها و دست آورد های بخش مربوطه، به منظور مطلع ساختن رهبری اداره.
اجرای سایر وظایف که از طرف مقامات ذیصلاح مطابق قوانین، مقررات و اهداف اداره سپرده میشود.
وظایف همآهنگی:
تامین هماهنگی بین آمریت های مرتبط بخش های اداره و خارج از اداره پیرامون موضوعات.
شریک نمودن نظریات و ارایه مشوره در حصه بهبود سیستم ها، روند کاری، ارتقای ظرفیت و غیره موارد با مدیریت بخش مربوطه.
شرایط استخدام:
تابعیت افغانستان را داشته باشد.
سن وی از (18) سال کمتر و از (64) سال بیشتر نباشد.
سویه تحصیلی :
داشتن سند تحصیلی حداقل لیسانس در یکی از رشته های ( کمپیوترساینس، سیستم های معلوماتی و انجنیری نرم افزار ) داخل یا خارج کشور که به تائید وزارت تحصیلات عالی رسیده باشد.
تجربه کاری:
حداقل دو سال مرتبط به وظیفه.
مهارت های لازم :
قابلیت طرح و تعین خط مشی (پالیسی ) اداره/ وزارت مربوطه.
تسلط به یکی از زبان ‌های رسمی ملی (پشتو یا دری) و آشنایی با زبان انگلیسی؛
مهارت ‌های کمپیوتری در برنامه ‌های مرتبط به وظیفه مربوطه.
بلدیت با تکنالوژی های ویب، فریم ورک ها و کتابخانه ها، مانند:
JavaScript, React, Next.js, Version control systems, and Agile methodology
مهارت تحلیل نیازمندی ها، حل مساله ها و کارتیمی.
بلدیت با دیتابیس های SQL , NoSQL
بلدیت با SDLC و Main software Engineering principles
بلدیت به زبان های برنامه نویسی، مانند: Java, Python, PHP, C#

علاقمندان واجد شرایط می توانند که سی وی و درخواستی خویش را در یک فایل پی دی اف به ایمیل ادرس ذیل ارسال نمایند

نصب، عیارسازی، پیکربندی و نگهداری تجهیزات شبکه Cisco Router, Switches, Firewall.
طرح و تطبیق پالیسی‌های امنیتی جهت محافظت از شبکه در برابر تهدیدات داخلی و خارجی و دسترسی‌های غیرمجاز
نظارت از عملکرد شبکه و تجهیزات، تهیه و نگهداری نسخه‌های احتیاطی (Backup) مدیریت و نظارت بر Disaster Recovery (DR) Site و همکاری در تطبیق پلان‌های ، Recovery (BCDR). Business Continuity and Disaster
تنظیم و مدیریت تجهیزات سیسکو و پروتوکول‌های مسیریابی، از جمله Routing Protocols, Swtching protocols
تنظیم و مدیریت ارتباطات بین شبکه‌های داخلی، مراکز معلومات، شعبات و سیستم‌های بیرونی از طریق VPN, IPsec, Routing and Switching..
نظارت و تحلیل عملکرد شبکه و دیتاسنتر از طریق سیستم‌های Network Monitoring, Performance Monitoring and Troubleshooting
مدیریت، نظارت و نگهداری زیربناهای Data Center سیستم AFMIS ، شامل Servers, Storage Systems, Virtualization Platforms, و Racks تجهیزات شبکه‌ای مربوطه .
حصول اطمینان از ارائه خدمات Lease line برای واحد های بودیجوی و مستوفیت ها
تدویر برنامه‌های آموزشی برای کارمندان جهت استفاده صحیح و مؤثر از تجهیزات و خدمات تکنالوژی معلوماتی .
ترتیب پروپوزل‌ها و مشخصات تخنیکی معیاری برای پروژه‌های توسعه و ارتقای تکنالوژی معلوماتی در مرکز و ولایات .
نظارت بر نصب و تطبیق به‌روزرسانی‌های امنیتی ( Security Patches) و نسخه‌های اصلاحی Firmware تجهیزات شبکه و فایروال‌ها، هماهنگی برای انجام آزمایش‌های لازم پیش از تطبیق و تهیه پلان بازگشت به وضعیت قبلی در صورت بروز مشکل.
نظارت و تحلیل رویدادها و لاگ‌های امنیتی شبکه، بررسی فعالیت‌های مشکوک، شناسایی آسیب‌پذیری‌های امنیتی و هماهنگی با بخش امنیت سایبری جهت رسیدگی به حوادث امنیتی و اتخاذ اقدامات اصلاحی لازم
ه مکاری در تطبیق و نظارت بر تفکیک منطقی شبکه از طریق VLAN ، Access Control Lists (ACLs) و سایر میکانیزم‌های کنترولی، به‌منظور محدودسازی دسترسی میان شبکه‌های کاربران، سرورها، مدیریت تجهیزات و سیستم‌های حساس
حصول اطمینان از ثبت و بررسی تغییرات پیکربندی تجهیزات شبکه و امنیتی، نگهداری نسخه‌های احتیاطی تنظیمات ( Configuration Backups) و آزمایش امکان بازیابی آن‌ها مطابق طرزالعمل‌های منظورشده.

location: Kabul - ریاست سیستم های مالی افغانستان
description:
Job Summary
هدف وظیفه: کمک با ادارات و مسؤلین امارتی در مورد عملیات های فنی سیستم معلوماتی مالی امارت جهت حل مشکلات تخنیکی

Job Requirements
وظایف و مسئولیت ها:
وظایف تخصصی:
نصب، پیکربندی و نگهداری سیستم‌عامل‌ها ( Windows Server ، Linux )
مدیریت Active Directory ، DNS ، DHCP ، Group Policy
مدیریت کاربران، دسترسی‌ها و سطح امنیت
مانیتورینگ عملکرد سرورها و رفع مشکلات ( Troubleshooting )
پیاده‌سازی و مدیریت Backup و Restore و مدیریت Storage و File Server
طراحی و پیاده‌سازی زیرساخت مجازی‌سازی ( VMware ESXi, Vcenter ، Hyper-V )
ساخت، تنظیم و مدیریت Virtual Machines (VMs) .
مدیریت Resource ها ( CPU ، RAM ، Storage ).
پیاده‌سازی High Availability (HA) و Failover .
مانیتورینگ زیرساخت مجازی‌سازی .
تطبیق به ‌روزرسانی ‌ها و وصله‌های امنیتی (Security Patches) برای سیستم‌عامل‌ها، نرم‌افزارهای زیرساختی و پلتفرم‌های مجازی‌سازی، مطابق با طرزالعمل‌های تأییدشده .
طراحی و تطبیق راهکارهای افزونگی (Redundancy) و تحمل خطا (Fault Tolerance) برای کاهش خطر توقف خدمات و افزایش پایداری زیرساخت .
تشخیص و رفع مشکلات پیچیده سیستم‌عامل‌ها، سرویس‌های زیرساختی، ماشین‌های مجازی و منابع ذخیره‌سازی، با استفاده از ابزارهای تشخیصی و تحلیل لاگ‌ها .
مدیریت امنیت Active Directory و Domain Controllers: تطبیق تنظیمات امنیتی برای Active Directory ، Domain Controllers ، Group Policy و حساب‌های کاربری؛ شناسایی و رفع تنظیمات نادرست، حساب‌های غیرفعال، مجوزهای غیرضروری و ضعف‌های امنیتی مرتبط با احراز هویت و مدیریت هوی
تأمین امنیت پلتفرم‌های مجازی‌سازی: تطبیق تنظیمات امنیتی در VMware ESXi ، vCenter و Hyper-V ، محدودسازی دسترسی مدیریتی، جداسازی شبکه‌های مدیریتی، محافظت از رابط‌های مدیریتی و بررسی دوره‌ای تنظیمات امنیتی مطابق با معیارهای تأییدشده .
مدیریت امنیت لاگ‌ها و ثبت رویدادها ( Logging and Auditing): فعال‌سازی و تنظیم ثبت رویدادهای امنیتی در سیستم‌عامل‌ها، Active Directory ، سرورها و پلتفرم‌های مجازی‌سازی؛ تأمین نگهداری امن لاگ‌ها، جلوگیری از دست‌کاری غیرمجاز.
مدیریت امنیت حساب‌های خدماتی و ارتباطات سیستمی ( Service Accounts): شناسایی و مستندسازی حساب‌های خدماتی، محدودسازی امتیازات آن‌ها، جلوگیری از استفاده غیرضروری از حساب‌های دارای دسترسی ممتاز، مدیریت امن رمزهای عبور و بررسی دوره‌ای مجوزها و فعالیت‌های این حساب‌ها.

تهیه و ترتیب پلان کاری ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه در مطابقت با پلان عمومی ریاست عمومی خزاین ، بمنظور رسیدن به اهداف ت عیین شده اداره.

تحکیم ارتباط با کلیه بخش ادارات مربوط جهت تقویه و انکشاف نرم افزار و سایر سیستم های مالی.

title: 285 - کارشناس سیستم و مجازی سازی
location: Kabul - ریاست سیستم های مالی افغانستان
description:
Job Summary
هدف وظیفه: کمک با ادارات و مسوءلین امارتی در مورد عملیات های فنی سیستم معلوماتی مالی امارت جهت حل مشکلات تخنیکی

Job Requirements
وظایف و مسئولیت ها:
وظایف تخصصی:
نصب، پیکربندی و نگهداری سیستم‌عامل‌ها ( Windows Server ، Linux )
مدیریت Active Directory ، DNS ، DHCP ، Group Policy
مدیریت کاربران، دسترسی‌ها و سطح امنیت
مانیتورینگ عملکرد سرورها و رفع مشکلات ( Troubleshooting )
پیاده‌سازی و مدیریت Backup و Restore و مدیریت Storage و File Server
طراحی و پیاده‌سازی زیرساخت مجازی‌سازی ( VMware ESXi ، Hyper-V )
ساخت، تنظیم و مدیریت Virtual Machines (VMs) .
مدیریت Resource ها ( CPU ، RAM ، Storage ).
پیاده‌سازی High Availability (HA) و Failover .
مانیتورینگ زیرساخت مجازی‌سازی .
تطبیق به ‌روزرسانی ‌ها و وصله‌های امنیتی (Security Patches) برای سیستم‌عامل‌ها، نرم‌افزارهای زیرساختی و پلتفرم‌های مجازی‌سازی، مطابق با طرزالعمل‌های تأییدشده .
طراحی و تطبیق راهکارهای افزونگی (Redundancy) و تحمل خطا (Fault Tolerance) برای کاهش خطر توقف خدمات و افزایش پایداری زیرساخت .
مدیریت تغییرات تخنیکی (Change Management) در زیرساخت سیستم‌ها و مجازی‌سازی، شامل ارزیابی خطر، مستندسازی، تأیید تغییرات و تهیه پلان بازگشت در صورت بروز مشکل .
وظایف مدیریتی:
تهیه و ترتیب پلان کاری ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه در مطابقت با پلان عمومی ریاست عمومی خزاین ، بمنظور رسیدن به اهداف ت عیین شده اداره.
ارائه گزارش ماهوار، ربعوار، سالانه و عندالضرورت از فعالیت ها و دست آورد های آمریت مربوطه، به منظور مطلع ساختن رهبری وزارت.
اجرای سایر وظایف که از طرف آمر مربوطه مطابق قوانین، مقررات و اهداف وزارت مربوطه سپرده میشود.
وظایف هماهنگی:
تامین ارتباط و هماهنگی با تمام بخش های ذیربط جهت انسجام و پیشبرد بهتر امور.
تحکیم ارتباط با کلیه بخش ادارات مربوط جهت تقویه و انکشاف نرم افزار و سایر سیستم های مالی.
حل چالش ها و مشکلات بخش های مربوطه به سیستم های مالی و کمپیوتری.
شرایط استخدام:
تابعیت افغانستان را داشته باشد
سن وی از (۱۸) سال کمتر و از (۶۴) بیشتر نباشد.
سویه تحصیلی:
داشتن سند تحصیلی حد اقل لیسانس در یکی از رشته های کمپیوتر ساینس، تکنالوژی معلوماتی ، و سیستم های معلوماتی و یا معادل آن داخل یا خارج کشور که به تائید وزارت تحصیلات عالی رسیده باشد.
تجربه کاری:
تجربه کاری حد اقل ۲ سال مرتبط به وظیفه
مهارت‌های لازم:
توانایی رهنمایی و کنترول بخش مربوطه.
قابلیت طرح و تعیین خط مشی (پالیسی) اداره/ وزارت مربوطه.
تسلط به زبان‌های رسمی (پشتو ، دری) و آشنایی (تحریر و تکلم) با زبان انگلیسی.

Submission Guideline
علاقمندان واجد شرایط می توانند که سی وی و درخواستی خویش را در یک فایل پی دی اف به ایمیل ادرس ذیل ارسال نمایند
نوت: لطف نموده درعنوان ایمیل خود نام بست و یا کود نمبر آنرا بنویسید ضم کردن اسناد تحصیلی، تجارب کاری و غیره فعلاً

title: Senior MEAL Associate
description:
Job Description
Under the overall supervision of the Chief of Mission (CoM), Programme Support Unit Coordinator and the direct supervision of the M&E officer the successful candidate will be responsible for providing technical support and coordinating the implementation monitoring and evaluation activities across different program.
Responsibilities
Plan for and support the undertaking of PDM and any other M&E data collection exercises; periodically review the project M&E monitoring tools and plans to guide M&E activities.
With guidance from the M&E Officer, coordinate the development, testing, roll out and regular revision of standardized M&E and reporting tools, within the program strategy and donor’s requirements, respecting formats, deadlines, and specific protocols, and engaging in crossed fertilization of ideas implementing partners.
Coordinate the process for identifying the key performance questions, indicators and parameters for all project development, monitoring projects’ performance and achievements,
Monitor ongoing activities of the programme; periodically and consistently aggregate and analyse data on respective projects’ indicators and develop indicator (IPTT) status reports and statistics to inform project management of progress of results achievement and for other purposes such as periodic and final reports, project visibility and communications; and
Coordinate the consolidation of monthly M&E report and Track unit workplan implementation of respective projects and support the production of regular monitoring reports. Prepare a trend analysis report from out PDM and other datas
Carry out periodic field visits using appropriate M&E tools to monitor the activities, beneficiaries and promote adherence to agreed M&E standards and norms; undertake M&E data quality assurance and data verification; identify bottlenecks impeding project delivery and gather feedback about IOM’s work among others.
Provide technical recommendations to the Project Manager, based on rolling analysis of and reporting on programming.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications and Experience
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Development, Economics, Management and, or related Social or Political Science fields from an accredited academic institution with 5 years of relevant experience; or
School diploma with seven years of relevant professional experience
Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database.
Experience
Minimum of seven years ( five years for degree holders) relevant experience in monitoring and evaluation of programmes related to migration management, particularly counter human trafficking, return and reintegration, direct assistance to vulnerable migrants including victims of trafficking.
Skills
Demonstrated experience in monitoring and evaluation – with specific experience in project development, data analysis, knowledge management, monitoring, and evaluation in the non-profit sector;
Demonstrated proficiency with MS office and advanced data science and/or statistical skills including knowledge of database management, statistical and project management software and data visualization skills is a strong advantage;
Excellent data visualization, analysis and writing skills
Proven ability to establish and maintain strong working relations with relevant Government counterparts, international organizations, and private sector entities.
Note: Strong preference for female candidates .
Languages
For all Applicants, fluency in English is required (oral and written).
Working knowledge of Pashto or Dari is required.
Fluency in all national language(s) are highly advantages.
Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.
Required Competencies
IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.
Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:
Inclusion and respect for diversity : Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.
Integrity and transparency : Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.
Professionalism : Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.
Courage : Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.
Empathy : Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.
Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2
Teamwork : Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.
Delivering results : Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.
Managing and sharing knowledge : Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.
Accountability : Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.
Communication : Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.
Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2, if with direct reports
Leadership : Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential.
Empowering others : Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential.
Building Trust : Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty.
Strategic thinking and vision : Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction.
Humility : Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings.
Notes
Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category.
Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation.
This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months.
Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances.
IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities.
IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts.
IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application.
No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies
