Job Summary
هدف وظیفه:
طراحی و توسعه سیستم‌ های نرم ‌افزاری مالی به منظور افزایش کارایی سیستم ها، ایجاد راهکارهای تخنیکی معیاری، پایدار و قابل اعتماد برای حمایت از فعالیت ‌های مالی اداره.

Job Requirements
صلاحیت و مسئولیت های وظیفوی:
وظایف تخصصی:
طراحی، انکشاف و توسعه سیستم ‌ها و اپلیکیشن ‌های نرم افزاری جدید مطابق نیازمندی ‌های اداره.
طراحی ساختار و اجزای تخنیکی نرم‌ افزار مطابق معیارهای توسعه
برنامه ‌نویسی و نوشتن کُدهای معیاری برای انکشاف و توسعه سیستم‌ها با استفاده از زبان‌هایی مانند C# ، .NET Core ، Java و تکنالوژی‌های مرتبط.
طراحی و توسعه رابط‌های برنامه ‌نویسی ( API ) برای اتصال سیستم‌ ها و سرویس‌های داخلی و خارجی.
تحلیل نیازمندی ‌های تخنیکی و تجارتی سیستم ‌ها و ارائه راهکارهای نرم ‌افزاری قابل تطبیق.
انجام آزمایشات نرم ‌افزاری جهت اطمینان از کیفیت و کارکرد درست سیستم‌ ها.
تهیه، به ‌روزرسانی و نگهداری اسناد تخنیکی سیستم‌ ها.
رعایت و تطبیق معیارها، رهنمود ها و بهترین شیوه‌ های توسعه نرم‌ افزار در تمام مراحل انکشاف سیستم.
تشخیص و رفع مشکلات تخنیکی سیستم ‌ها در جریان توسعه و بهره برداری.
همکاری تخنیکی با اعضای تیم توسعه، طراحان و تیم تطبیق در جریان پیاده‌ سازی سیستم ‌ها.
اشتراک در بازبینی کُدها ( Code Review ) و ارائه پیشنهادات تخنیکی جهت بهبود کیفیت توسعه.
همکاری تخنیکی با تیم ‌های تحلیل، تطبیق و نگهداری سیستم‌ ها .
انتقال مهارت ‌ها و تجارب تخنیکی به همکاران در جریان کار .
انجام سایر وظایف مرتبط با توسعه نرم ‌افزار مطابق هدایت آمر مربوطه .
وظایف مدیریتی:
رهنمایی تخنیکی تیم توسعه در خصوص معیارهای کد نویسی و طراحی سیستم ‌ها.
ارزیابی کیفیت کارهای تخنیکی انجام‌ شده در چارچوب پروژه ‌ها.
ترتیب و ارائه گزارش‌های تخنیکی و پیشرفت کار به آمر مربوطه.
وظایف هماهنگی:
هماهنگی با تیم ‌های تحلیل، تطبیق و نگهداری سیستم ‌ها.
تأمین هماهنگی با ادارات ذیربط در جریان انکشاف سیستم ‌های مالی به‌ منظور جلوگیری از نادرستی در درک پروسه ‌ها .
همکاری با کاربران و ذیربطین در رفع مشکلات تخنیکی سیستم‌ ها.
اشتراک در جلسات تخنیکی و کاری مرتبط با پروژه‌ های توسعه نرم‌افزار.
شرایط استخدام:
تابعیت افغانستان را داشته باشد
سن وی از (۱۸) سال کمتر و از (۶۴) بیشتر نباشد.
سویه تحصیلی:
داشتن سند تحصیلی حد اقل لیسانس در یکی از رشته ‌های کمپیوتر ساینس، تکنالوژی معلوماتی، انجنیری نرم‌ افزار، سیستم‌ های معلوماتی یا سایر رشته‌ های تخنیکی مرتبط از مؤسسات تحصیلی ملی یا بین‌المللی داخل یا خارج کشور که به تأیید وزارت تحصیلات عالی رسیده باشد؛ به درجات تحصیلی بالاتر و داشتن اسناد تخصصی مرتبط ارجحیت داده می‌ شود.

تجربه کاری حد اقل سه سال مرتبط به وظیفه

تسلط به مفاهیم توسعه نرم افزار و برنامه نویسی
مهارت تحلیل مشکلات تخنیکی سیستم ها
توانایی کار تیمی و هماهنگی تخنیکی
آشنایی با معیاری های کیفیت نرم افزار
تسلط به زبان های رسمی (دری، پشتو) و آشنایی با زبان انگلیسی

description:
Job Summary
هدف وظیفه:
طراحی، انکشاف، مدیریت و محافظت دیتابیس‌ های معیاری، مصئون و پایدار به‌ منظور تضمین دسترسی به معلومات دقیق، قابل اعتماد و به ‌موقع، حمایت از سیستم ‌های مالی ریاست عمومی خزاین و تأمین امنیت و یکپارچگی معلومات مطابق قوانین و مقررات نافذه.

Job Requirements
وظایف و مسئولیت ها:
وظایف تخصصی:
طراحی، ایجاد و مدیریت دیتابیس‌های مورد نیاز سیستم‌ ها .
تحلیل نیازمندی‌های دیتابیس و طراحی ساختار منطقی و فزیکی آن .
مراقبت و محافظت از دیتابیس ‌های موجود به منظور جلوگیری از حملات سایبری، ویروس‌ ها و دسترسی ‌های غیرمجاز به معلومات ذخیره‌ شده .
مدیریت دسترسی‌ها، نقش‌ها و صلاحیت‌های کاربران دیتابیس .
مدیریت و نظارت بر پروسه‌های Backup و Recovery

title: Associate Officer ICT
description:
Details
Mission and objectives
UNAMA was established in 2002 as a Political/ Peacebuilding Mission, exceptionally) directed and supported by the UN Department of
Peacekeeping Operations (DPKO).
Context
The UNV Associate Officer ICT will contribute to these objectives by providing technical and operational support for security-related ICT systems, databases, applications and infrastructure, strengthening system reliability, information management, operational continuity and the Security Section's capacity to respond effectively to evolving security requirements.
On 15 June 2026, the United Nations Security Council unanimously adopted resolution 2822 (2026), extending the mandate of the United Nations Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA) until 17 June 2027. The Mission's mandate, as established under resolution 2626 (2022) and subsequently extended, includes promoting and facilitating humanitarian assistance, supporting human rights and the rights of women and girls, advancing inclusive governance, strengthening resilience and economic stability, and exercising good offices to promote constructive engagement, peace and stability in Afghanistan.
The Security Council has underscored the critical importance of UNAMA's continued presence, together with United Nations agencies, funds and programmes, throughout Afghanistan, and the need to ensure the safety, security and freedom of movement of United Nations and associated personnel. In this context, the UNAMA Security Section supports the implementation of the Mission's mandate by facilitating the safe and secure conduct of United Nations operations in a complex and challenging security environment.
The Security Section relies on specialized and integrated information and communications technology (ICT) systems to support the protection of United Nations personnel, premises, assets and operations. These include electronic identification and access-control platforms, Pass & ID servers and databases, physical security and surveillance systems, security communications infrastructure, personnel-accountability applications and operational security information-management tools across Kabul and field duty stations.
These systems support countrywide identification and badging, personnel tracking, real-time Who-Is-In/Who-Is-Out information, emergency recall and bunker accountability, and timely operational visibility for the Security Operations Centre (SOC), Country Security Operations Centre (C-SOC), Guard Force and other authorized security components. They also facilitate incident analysis, access-log retrieval, identity verification, information integrity and the secure management of operational security records.
The Associate Officer ICT assignment provides dedicated technical capacity for the development, administration, integration, maintenance and continuous improvement of these mission-critical systems, in coordination with UNAMA ICT and other responsible technical service providers. Particular emphasis is placed on system availability, information security, operational resilience, emergency preparedness, backup and recovery arrangements, technical documentation and structured knowledge transfer to ensure the continuity and reliability of security-related ICT services throughout Afghanistan.
Task description
Within delegated authority and under the supervision of the Deputy Chief Security Officer (DCSO), or designated representative, and in close coordination with UNAMA ICT and relevant Security Section technical and operational units, the UN Volunteer will undertake the following tasks:
A. Security Information Systems, Applications and Identity Management
• Administer, maintain, enhance and, where required, develop the Security Section's databases, web-based applications, SharePoint solutions and electronic information-management systems, ensuring functionality, information security, data integrity and operational reliability.
• Provide technical administration and support for the Security Section's Pass & ID infrastructure, including identification databases, badge-production applications, associated servers and electronic identification services for UNAMA and United Nations agencies, funds and programmes operating in Afghanistan.
• Support the modernization, interoperability and authorized integration of electronic identification and access-control systems with relevant United Nations platforms, including TRIP and FSS, in coordination with designated system owners and technical service providers.
• Develop, maintain and improve electronic daily staff lists, personnel-accountability applications, security incident reporting and analysis tools, and other customized applications supporting operational security information management.
• Support the administration and technical functionality of identity-verification systems, access-control records, authorized access-log retrieval and electronic personnel-tracking applications, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity and availability of security-related information.
B. Operational Security ICT Systems, Emergency Preparedness and Business Continuity
• Provide specialized technical support to information and communications systems supporting the Security Operations Centre (SOC), Country Security Operations Centre (C-SOC), Guard Force and other designated Security Section units, including system monitoring, troubleshooting, service restoration and operational continuity.
• Support the installation, configuration, maintenance and technical interoperability of ICT-enabled physical security systems, including electronic access control, surveillance and CCTV interfaces, personnel-tracking applications, perimeter-security technologies and security communications infrastructure, within assigned technical responsibilities.
• Support the technical readiness and reliable operation of electronic systems used for emergency preparedness, personnel accountability, emergency recall, real-time Who-Is-In/Who-Is-Out information, bunker accountability and other authorized security emergency-management arrangements.
• Assist in maintaining the availability, resilience and continuity of mission-critical security ICT services, including the identification of technical vulnerabilities, escalation of system disruptions, implementation of approved corrective measures and coordination of technical recovery arrangements.
• Implement and periodically test approved data backup, restoration, system-recovery and information-protection procedures, maintaining accurate technical records and supporting continuity arrangements for critical security applications.
• Provide technical assistance in the assessment and resolution of hardware, software, network connectivity and system-integration issues affecting security operations, coordinating with UNAMA ICT and other responsible technical service providers as required.
C. Technical Coordination, Documentation, Capacity Development and Knowledge Transfer
• Liaise with Security Section operational units and relevant ICT service providers to identify technical requirements, assess system performance and recommend improvements to electronic security systems, operational applications and information-management processes.
• Contribute to the preparation of technical specifications, functional requirements and assessments for the procurement, replacement, and upgrading and maintenance of ICT equipment, software and electronic security technologies, in accordance with applicable United Nations procedures.
• Develop and maintain technical standard operating procedures, system documentation, user instructions, configuration records, troubleshooting guidance and relevant information-security controls.
• Provide technical guidance, user orientation, practical training and workshops for Security Section personnel in Kabul and field duty stations on identification systems, security applications, electronic accountability tools and other assigned ICT services.
• Support structured knowledge transfer, technical handover, system documentation and capacity development to ensure continuity of critical security ICT services during personnel transitions and organizational changes.
• Coordinate with relevant technical and operational counterparts on authorized system upgrades, application integration, information-security requirements, technical risk mitigation and the implementation of approved system improvements.
• Perform other related ICT duties consistent with the assignment and delegated responsibilities.

title: IT & Admin Officer
location: Herat - Herat with covering site offices
description:
Job Summary
Job Purpose
The IT Officer is responsible for ensuring secure, reliable, and effective ICT services across War Child Afghanistan operations. The role provides technical support, Microsoft 365 user administration, Windows Server management, infrastructure support, endpoint security, and vendor coordination while ensuring compliance with organizational ICT policies, security standards, and operational continuity. The position plays a key role in maintaining business-critical systems, supporting staff productivity, safeguarding organizational information assets, and enabling efficient day-to-day operations.
Job Description
The Duties and responsibilities may include but not limited to:
1. ICT Support & Operations
Provides first and second-line ICT support to staff in Herat and field offices.
Installs, configures, maintains, and troubleshoots computer hardware, software, operating systems, printers, scanners, and peripheral devices.
Resolves internet, email, network, and application-related issues to ensure uninterrupted operations.
Supports staff by providing troubleshooting, system guidance, and ICT-related training
Responds to ICT service requests and service tickets in a timely and professional manner
Maintains ICT equipment inventory and prepares regular ICT maintenance and service reports.
2. Microsoft 365 & Endpoint Management
Supports organizational email services and user lifecycle management, including user onboarding and offboarding, access management, password resets, and authentication support
Assists users with Microsoft Office applications, email systems, and collaboration tools.
Maintains standardized and updated workstation configurations across all offices.
Ensures compliance with authorized software standards by implementing and monitoring approved software installation policies on user devices.
Ensures compliance with ICT standards and user access controls across organizational systems.
3. Infrastructure, Servers & Security
Administers and maintains LAN, WAN, and VPN infrastructure to support office operations, connectivity, and secure remote access.
Monitors and maintains computer systems, networks, and related ICT infrastructure across country offices.
Manages the setup, configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of network security appliances, including firewall policies, VPN connectivity, and security controls
Provides wireless network support and maintains network reliability for staff and guests
Supports data integrity, information security, and secure ICT operations.

Ournative token NTE (Node Meta Energy) is live on BNB Smart Chain with a cappedsupply of 11 billion tokens and a 10-year halving strategy. The mining andstaking ecosystem is already operational, with users earning daily rewardsthrough our decentralized node-based infrastructure.
Wewere recognized as the BestDecentralized Ecosystem at the 2025 Evergreen Awards — and now we'rebuilding the team to deliver on the next phase.
What We're Building — Product Development Status NodeMetais developing four interconnected products. Here's what's live, what's inactive development, and where this role fits in:
1. Mining Staking Ecosystem
Status: LIVE ✓
Thefoundation of NodeMeta. Users participate in a decentralized node-based miningsystem and earn daily NTE rewards. The staking smart contracts are deployed onBSC mainnet and operational. This is the revenue-generating backbone of theecosystem — real users, real tokens, real on-chain activity.
Your involvement: Maintain, optimize, and extendexisting staking contracts. Improve gas efficiency and prepare for the nextphase of staking features (NFT-based staking, tiered reward structures).
2. NFT Marketplace
Status: IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT — architecturephase
Adecentralized marketplace for NFTs with a differentiator: real-world utility.NFTs on our platform aren't just collectibles — they unlock benefits, access,and rewards within the NodeMeta ecosystem. The marketplace will supportminting, listing, bidding, trading, and on-chain staking of NFTs withper-second reward accrual.
Your involvement: This is the core of your role.You'll design and implement the marketplace smart contracts from scratch —BEP-721/BEP-1155 minting, trading/auction logic, and the NFT staking engine(reward calculation, lock-up periods, safe withdrawal flows). You'll own thecontract architecture.
3. SmartCommerce
Status: IN DEVELOPMENT — design phase
Aplatform where users spend NTE tokens on real digital and physical goods —bridging blockchain and everyday commerce. This is what makes NodeMetadifferent from most Web3 projects: we're building actual utility for the tokenbeyond speculation. SmartCommerce requires on-chain payment contracts,settlement logic, escrow mechanisms, and integration points with off-chainfulfillment systems.
Your involvement: Design the on-chain payment andsettlement contracts. Build the escrow logic that protects both buyers andsellers. Work closely with the backend team to ensure on-chain payments triggerreal-world fulfillment reliably.
4. GreenCommerce
Status: PLANNED
Anexclusive marketplace for environmentally friendly products — eco-consciouselectronics, reusable home products, green building materials, and clean energysolutions. GreenCommerce will share the SmartCommerce contract infrastructurewith additional sustainability-focused features.
Your involvement: Future phase. Contracts you buildfor SmartCommerce will be extended for GreenCommerce, so your architecturaldecisions now directly shape this product.

▸ Designand implement NFT minting contracts (BEP-721 and BEP-1155)
▸ Buildtrading logic — listings, bids, auctions, direct sales with escrow

▸ Designthe reward token distribution mechanism for staked NFTs
SmartCommerce PaymentContracts
▸ Buildon-chain payment acceptance and validation logic
▸ Designescrow contracts for buyer/seller protection

description:
Overview
We’re 8020 — We help companies + creators like Wave , Vanta , Superlist , , Huberman Lab , Hasan Minhaj , Alltrue , Helix (Q2) , and many more move faster without code. Whether they’re a seed-stage startup or a publicly-traded enterprise, brands around the world every day rely on 8020 to design, develop, and launch the internet's most ambitious websites.
About This Opening
We're seeking a talented Webflow Developer to join temporarily our remote team at 8020 . With a strong reputation in the industry, we’re offering the chance to contribute to forward-thinking Webflow projects for some of the largest names on the internet. As part of a collaborative team, you can work alongside exceptional project managers, designers, and senior developers, creating an environment that encourages personal and professional development.
What We're Looking For
Experience: You're an experienced developer with at least 2 or 3 years of Webflow experience and a portfolio of past work to showcase. You have a strong track record of delivering successful Webflow sites in business settings.
Efficient: You're comfortable using a development framework like Mast or similar frameworks, and constantly seek opportunities to improve your workflow + speed.
Communicative: You excel in asynchronous communication through written channels (Slack, ClickUp) or video (Loom) and consistently engage with teammates and clients. Figma to Webflow: You'll primarily collaborate with our design team or clients, translating design files (often in Figma) into dynamic, visually appealing websites.

You will need to evaluate websites from several perspectives including SEO, accessibility, and performance, and translate your findings into clear and strategic recommendations.

Be a Good Partner: At 8020 , we pride ourselves on being an exceptional and trusted partner to our clients. We approach decision-making as if we were owners of their businesses and rely on you to assist clients in making strategic choices for their success.

You are comfortable working with Airtable or similar tools to structure data, and you understand Webflow’s CMS capabilities well enough to propose clear and scalable ways to manage that data during and after the migration.
Where You'll Do It‍
This is a remote-first position open to candidates anywhere in the world. Significant preference will be given to candidates available to work during the Eastern to Pacific time zones.

Developers with a proven track record of successfully collaborating with clients or stakeholders in professional environments.
Developers with proficiency in Webflow's underlying code output: HTML, CSS, and basic Javascript. (If you have moderate-to-advanced proficiency in writing Javascript or JQuery, we recommend noting it in your application.)

title: Senior IT Security Officer
description:
Role Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior IT Security Officer to join our team and oversee the protection and security of our organization's IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving efforts to prevent, monitor, and respond to information/data breaches and cyber-attacks, ensuring the execution of Information Security directives and activities in alignment with the company's data security policy.

Duties and Responsibilities
1. Design, update, and enforce enterprise-wide security policies, standards, and procedures aligned with industry frameworks and Organization’s security policies.
2. Coordinate security awareness programs and train employees on cybersecurity best practices, threat recognition and ensure compliance with security regulations and standards.
3. Oversee the execution of comprehensive security assessments and compliance audits to proactively identify vulnerabilities and recommend security enhancements.
4. Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, security audits, and risk analyses to identify gaps and implement effective mitigation strategies.
5. Ensure security incidents are managed and forensic investigations are executed when necessary.
6. Cross-functional collaboration is maintained to systematically address emerging security concerns and implement security best practices.
7. Lead the detection, investigation, and response efforts for security breaches, cyberattacks, or system anomalies
8. Provide strategic guidance and recommendations to enhance the organization's overall security posture.
9. A comprehensive understanding of current security trends, advanced threat, and emerging technologies is maintained to ensure potential systemic risks are proactively mitigated.
10. Develop and maintain security incident response plans and procedures.
11. Lead and mentor a team of security professionals to ensure effective execution of security initiatives.
12. Act as a technical liaison to upper management, legal teams, and external auditors to ensure regulatory and data privacy compliance.
13. Ensure compliance with industry regulations, standards, and best practices.
14. Supervise and maintain security systems, including firewalls, SIEM platforms, and endpoint protection tools.

Job Requirements
Qualifications & Skills
· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
· Proven experience in a senior-level information security role, with a strong track record of implementing, managing, and improving information security programs and initiatives.
· A minimum of 2–4 years of relevant experience in IT, information security, or cybersecurity.
· In-depth knowledge of information security principles, best practices, and technologies, including network security, encryption, identity and access management, risk management, and security incident response.
· Excellent communication, leadership, and analytical skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical risks to non-technical stakeholders, and report security matters to senior management.
· Certification of ISO/IEC 27001, CompTIA Security +, CISSP, CISM are highly preferred.
Personal Attributes
· High level of integrity and ability to handle sensitive financial systems
· Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure
· Detail-oriented with a strong focus on documentation and audit readiness

Submission Guidelines
Interested and qualified candidates are invited to submit their CV and cover letter (in PDF format) to jobs@aurumaf.com
Please mention the position title “Senior IT Security Officer” in the subject line of your email.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview

title: Dutch Audio Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
Project Overview
We are sourcing independent Audio Evaluation Specialists for an AI benchmark evaluation project assessing advanced agentic audio models. As AI models increasingly handle complex workflows in this domain—specifically real-world customer support scenarios like flight bookings, financial services, and telecommunications—their accuracy relies entirely on robust, expert-crafted training data. The objective of this project is to autonomously produce high-quality evaluation tasks through simulated interactions, audit conversational AI outputs, and generate clean, reliable datasets to optimize model performance.
Project Deliverables & Scope
Operate autonomously to design complex evaluation frameworks and provide structured training data. Expected deliverables include:
Role-Play Scenario Execution: Creating and executing complex, role-play-based evaluation scenarios that simulate realistic customer service interactions across travel, finance, and technical support domains.
Model Performance Auditing: Evaluating AI model performance across standardized qualitative and quantitative metrics, focusing strictly on task completion accuracy, conversational naturalness, and audio comprehension.
Technical Metric Evaluation: Assessing the model's basic computer programming literacy, including its understanding of JSON structures, functions, methods, and ability to reason about structured data within a support context.
Representative Dataset Generation: Contributing to the development of diverse, high-quality audio datasets that accurately reflect real customer expectations for clarity, efficiency, and natural conversational flow.
Required Expertise
To successfully fulfill the deliverables of this project, Contractors must possess deep industry knowledge to craft realistic professional scenarios. Core skillset includes:
Demonstrable professional expertise in complex customer support, technical troubleshooting, or conversational AI evaluation.
Native or bilingual proficiency in the target language, including fluency across all language skills (reading, listening, writing, and speaking), alongside strong analytical and verbal communication skills to confidently conduct simulated customer support role-plays.
Basic computer programming literacy, specifically a comfortable understanding of JSON structures, functions, methods, and simple logic.
A meticulous, detail-oriented approach to working with structured prompts, complex evaluation rubrics, and technical guidelines.
Required Equipment: Access to a high-quality microphone to ensure clean, reliable audio input during voice evaluations.
We offer a pay range of $6-to-$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.
Engagement Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor
Workplace Type: Remote
Seniority Level: Mid-Senior Level
Originally posted on Himalayas

مطالعه و تدقیق پروسه های کاری غرض تطبیق و مراقبت نظام ها (دیتابیس ها) و پیشنهاد راه حل جهت رفع موانع و چالش های نظام های متذکره .

تدوین و تطبیق طرح ها، پروسیجر های جدید کاری، طرز العمل ها و پلان عمل مطابق استراتیژی ریاست عمومی کیفیت مواد نفتی غرض تسریع روند حکومتداری الکترونیکی و ساده سازی پروسه های کاری .
حصول اطمینان از رفع مشکلات تخنیکی و مصئونیت نظام های اداره، تهیه Documentations ، و Backups .
حصول اطمینان از استفادۀ درست و مؤثر از نظام الکترونیکی ادارۀ به منظور هماهنگی، شفافیت و تسریع در پروسۀ کاری و اجراآت لازم طبق هدایت مقام ذیصلاح بخش .
مطالعه برنامه های جدید و اجراآت دوامدار غرض Update و توسعه نرم افزار های مورد استفاده ریاست عمومی کیفیت مواد نفتی .
اشتراک در کنفرانس ها و ورکشاپ های مربوط به نظام سازی جهت ارتقاء ظرفیت .
ارتباط موثر با اعضای تیم و Stakeholders به صورت شفاهی و کتبی غرض بهبود امور و سیستم های موجود وزارت مالیه .
رهبری و نظارت از فعالیت های تخنیکی و مسلکی مدیریت های عمومی کامره های امنیتی، تکنالوژی معلوماتی و نظام به منظور تأمین فعالیت مؤثر و منظم امور مربوطه.
نظارت از تنظیم صلاحیت های استفاده کننده ګان نظام معلوماتی مطابق مسؤولیت های وظیفوی و صلاحیت های منظور شده آنان و پیګری مشکلات مربوط به دسترسی و استفاده از نظام.
وظایف مدیریتی:
ترتیب و جمع آوری پلان کاری و راپور های ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه در مطابقت با پلان عمومی، بمنظور رسیدن به اهداف تعیین شده اداره.
انتقال مهارت های مسلکی به شیوه تدویر ورکشاپ ها، سیمینار ها و آموزش های جریان کار به کارکنان تحت اثر .
مدیریت، ارزیابی اجراات، تعیین نیاز های آموزشی و ارتقای ظرفیت کارکنان و بخش های تحت اثر
ارائه گزارش ماهوار، ربعوار، سالانه و عندالضرورت از فعالیت ها و دست آورد های مربوطه، بمنظور مطلع ساختن رهبری وزارت/اداره؛
اجرای سایر وظایف که از طرف مقامات ذیصلاح مطابق قوانین، مقررات و اهداف وزارت/ اداره مربوطه سپرده میشود .
وظایف هماهنگی:
تامین ارتباط و هماهنگی با ادارات و بخش های مربوطه به منظور انسجام امور بهتر.
شرایط استخدام :
تابعیت افغانستان را داشته باشد.
سن وی از (18) سال کمتر و از (64) سال بیشتر نباشد.
(سطح تحصیل و تجربه کاری):

داشتن سند تحصیلی حداقل لیسانس در یکی از رشته های ( کمپیوترساینس، سیستم های معلوماتی و انجنیری نرم افزار ) داخل یا خارج کشور که به تائید وزارت تحصیلات عالی رسیده باشد.

توانائی رهنمائی و کنترول بخش مربوطه.
قابلیت طرح و تعین خط مشی (پالیسی ) اداره/ وزارت مربوطه.
تسلط به هر دو زبان ‌های رسمی ملی (پشتو و دری) و آشنایی با زبان انگلیسی؛
مهارت ‌های کمپیوتری در برنامه ‌های مرتبط به وظیفه مربوطه.

بلدیت با دیتابیس های SQL , NoSQL

description:
Job Summary
Ramaki Group of Companies is seeking a qualified Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to define and execute the technology vision, strategy, and roadmap for its digital products and platforms. The role focuses on strategic leadership, secure and scalable infrastructure, regulatory compliance, and building a high-performing engineering team, all aligned with organizational business goals, customer needs, and industry standards.
The CTO will own the end-to-end technology function for Ramaki's fintech operations, from strategic planning and team development to vendor management and system reliability. The role combines strategic decision-making, cybersecurity oversight, regulatory and risk support, innovation, and cross-functional collaboration with the CEO, board, and compliance teams.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Leadership and Decision-Making
• Define the technology vision, strategy, and roadmap in line with business goals.
• Work with the CEO and executive team on product, growth, and investment decisions.
• Lead, hire, and develop the engineering team across backend, frontend, mobile and UI/UX.
• Report on technology progress, risks, and budget to the board and investors.
Cybersecurity and Infrastructure
• Oversee the security approach and make sure security is built into the platform.
• Ensure infrastructure, customer data protection, backup, and disaster recovery meet business needs and payment security standards such as PCI DSS.
Regulatory, Risk and Compliance Support
• Work with Compliance and Risk teams so systems support EMI requirements such as safeguarding, KYC/AML and transaction monitoring.
• Support audits and regulator or partner reviews on technical matters.
Technology Innovation and Vendor Management
• Select and manage technology vendors and partners, such as payment processors, card providers, banking partners and KYC providers, and own the technology budget.
• Evaluate new technologies that improve efficiency, security or customer experience.
Systems and Service Availability and Reliability
• Ensure the platform is reliable, scalable and available, with accurate transaction processing, clear SLAs and monitoring.
• Establish engineering processes for development, testing, release, and incident management.

Job Requirements
• 7+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years in fintech.
• Led engineering teams of 10+ across backend, frontend, mobile, and design.
• Launched and ran a regulated payments, e-money, banking, or card product.
• Strong in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and secure engineering.
• Knowledge of EMI and payments regulation, KYC/AML and safeguarding.
• Clear communicator with the board, regulators and non-technical colleagues.

description:
Headquarters: ignitionit.com

Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first
TL;DR
ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role.
We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you.
What the actual job???
Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.”
You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there.
In a typical week, you might:
Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless.
Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with.
Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing.
Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone.
Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline."
⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job.
About ignitionit.com
We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile!
What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way.
We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here.

About ZoomInfo
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute, you’ll make things happen, fast.
The Opportunity
ZoomInfo’s Core Data team builds the company and contact data behind the Go-To-Market Intelligence Platform: hundreds of millions of records, resolved to the right entity, kept accurate, and delivered to more than 35,000 customers.
The way that data is produced is changing. For years it came from deterministic pipelines: many sources, weighted and decayed, one winner per attribute. Core Data is now moving to AI-native data management, where an agent pursues the evidence for an entity, decides every attribute over all of it, and records why. The company and contact agents already exist as working, measured prototypes. What does not exist yet is the machinery that runs them at production volume, proves every version before it ships, and lets researchers and product managers operate them without an engineer in the loop.
We are hiring a Senior Applied AI Engineer to build and own that machinery. You will complete the entity-agent pipeline, build the evidence adapters behind a single envelope, run the benchmark and golden-gate system on a schedule, build the review and batch tooling the team operates, and carry the agents onto ZoomInfo’s Agentic Platform. You will work with the Principal AI Engineer who owns the benchmark harness and productionization, the product manager who owns evaluation and policy, and the company and person engineering teams that own the pipelines the agents feed. You will not be the only person who can do this work; you will be the second, so that neither of you is a single point of failure.
This is a role for someone who has shipped LLM systems in production with evaluations, builds platform for other people to operate, and can work inside a large-scale data pipeline. You should be as comfortable writing an adapter with a replayable store and a kill switch as you are reading a miss analysis with a product manager, and you should like that the prototype you take to production was built by a PM who commits code.
What You’ll Do
Run the benchmark and golden-gate system. Move judge runs, golden-gate results, arms scorecards, and cost per record from a laptop to a scheduled system against staging. Every agent version is gated automatically, with variance and drift tracked per release. The evaluation product manager sets the thresholds; you make them enforceable.
Complete the entity-agent pipeline. Build the stages that do not exist yet: enricher fan-out, location sets, and hierarchy batch files. Migrate the classifiers to the shared runner with the Principal AI Engineer so they run at production scale. Measure throughput and unit cost per stage on named cohorts, so the cost model comes from instrumentation rather than estimates.
Build the evidence adapters. Registries, live web, mail-tenant signals, and external research vendors all sit behind one envelope with a replayable vendor store, measured lift per shape, a per-vendor kill switch, and at least two sources per shape. Vendors are swappable by design.

title: Autonomous Systems Security Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote-Friendly (Travel Required) | San Francisco, CA
About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. You'll be the engineer who owns autonomous systems across that footprint as one security domain, from both sides: drones, ground robots and automated vehicles for patrol, inspection and moving hardware, including the security of that automation inside secure areas, and the detection systems that tell us what is flying over or operating near a site uninvited.
You set the approach, select and integrate the platforms and sensors, write the requirements vendors build to, and run what you ship, from the operating model where operators assign missions and machines carry them out to the playbook that turns a detection into an identified track and a well-evidenced handoff to whoever holds authority over the airspace. Interdiction is not part of this role. The goal is security that runs itself: coverage, fleet health and evidence verified continuously, with tools and AI agents doing the routine triage. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.
You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including its physical security systems engineers and the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's data center operations and legal teams, and directly with site operators, equipment vendors and aviation and public safety authorities. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure.
Key responsibilities
Autonomous security and inspection systems: own the drones, ground robots and other autonomous platforms for perimeter patrol, incident response and infrastructure inspection: platform selection, operating model, operator qualification, maintenance, and the data path from machine to analyst
Tools, automation and AI agents: build the integrations that carry detections, tracks, telemetry and fleet health into the team's security monitoring platform, and the tools and agents that triage detections, check fleet health and assemble evidence. When a review keeps costing people time, you build the tool or agent that retires it
Detection of uncrewed systems: engineer the sensing that tells us what is flying over or operating near a site, what it is and who needs to know: sensor selection and evaluation against live targets, per-site coverage, classification and false-alarm handling, and the playbook from first detection to handoff, with evidence retained
Security of site automation: engineer the controls on automated vehicles, robots and similar machines that move hardware or work inside secure areas: identity and access, network isolation, what they may record and where it goes, fail-secure behavior, their place in chain of custody, and acceptance before they enter a site
Regulatory and site constraints: establish what we may sense, fly, drive, record and retain at each site, partner-operated sites included, under the aviation, spectrum, privacy and safety rules that apply there, with the waivers and approvals that extend it and coordination with local authorities set up before it is needed
Health monitoring: define and test heartbeats, loss-of-coverage and lost-link alarms and fail-secure behavior, so a silent sensor or machine shows as a fault, not a quiet day

Are you a software engineer with deep infrastructure expertise and a systems-level mindset eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are increasingly responsible for reasoning about real-world systems, cloud architectures, and performance-critical infrastructure. With high-quality expert training data, tomorrow’s AI can better design, evaluate, and operate complex software systems at scale. That training data begins with you.
We’re looking for SWE Infrastructure Specialists fluent in JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python who specialize in systems thinking, software and infrastructure architecture, performance optimization, and quality engineering. You’ll challenge advanced language models on realistic infrastructure and platform scenarios involving cloud design, Infrastructure-as-Code abstractions, deployment workflows, scalability constraints, and failure modes. This work focuses on evaluating how models reason about architectural tradeoffs, abstraction layers, environment isolation, state management, and reliability across distributed systems.
On a typical day, you will converse with the model on infrastructure and platform engineering tasks using JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python, verify architectural soundness and logical correctness, assess code quality and testing strategies, analyze performance bottlenecks and deployment risks, capture reproducible failure cases, and suggest improvements to prompt design and evaluation metrics to strengthen model reasoning.
A bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related technical field is ideal. Real-world experience in cloud platforms, infrastructure engineering, platform or DevOps roles, performance analysis, or QA practices strongly signals fit. Clear technical communication and the ability to clearly articulate system-level reasoning and tradeoffs are essential.
Ready to turn your engineering expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.
We offer a pay range of $80-to-$150 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

title: Technical Support Engineer, Triage & Discovery
description:
Headquarters: Remote
Alloy is where you belong!
Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.
Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of Inc.Magazine’s Best Workplaces , Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers , Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker , year after year.
Check out our investors and read more about us here .
About the team
The Technical Support Engineer 2 (TSE2), Triage & Discovery is the front line of Alloy’s technical support experience. This role is responsible for engaging customers early, clarifying the true issue, gathering the right technical and business context, and preparing high-quality handoffs to senior Technical Support Engineers for deeper investigation and resolution. You’ll also directly resolve repeatable, well-defined support workflows—like implementation tasks and standard configurations—giving you meaningful ownership alongside your triage work.
This isn’t a role where you passively route tickets. You’ll dig into each request, ask sharp questions, get on short calls when it’ll move things faster, and build a clear picture of what’s actually going on. The best person for this role is someone who’s energized by customer interaction, comfortable navigating technical systems, and skilled at turning ambiguity into clarity. By improving the quality of initial problem discovery, you’ll help the entire support organization resolve issues faster, more accurately, and with less wasted effort.
Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week, and remote employees onsite once a quarter.
What you'll be doing
As a Technical Support Engineer 2, you will be responsible for triaging incoming support cases, leading customer discovery conversations, building high-quality handoffs for senior engineers, and directly resolving straightforward tickets—all using our ticketing system, Zendesk. You’ll be leveraging your technical skills, problem-solving instincts, written communication, and verbal skills to clarify customer issues and build trust with professionalism and empathy.
Responsibilities
Serve as the first technical point of contact for incoming support requests—respond quickly, ask targeted follow-up questions, and build a clear understanding of what the customer actually needs.
Get on short customer calls (15–30 minutes) when written back-and-forth isn’t getting to the heart of the issue fast enough. Lead these calls effectively, keeping them focused on discovery and triage.
Gather the evidence that matters—logs, screenshots, timestamps, configuration details, reproduction steps—so that the next person to touch the ticket can hit the ground running.
Write clean, structured internal notes and handoffs. When you route a ticket to a senior engineer, they should be able to start solving immediately without redoing your work.
Directly resolve straightforward product questions, technical clarifications, and clearly documented support tasks, including repeatable implementation workflows managed asynchronously over days or weeks.
Diagnose issues related to Alloy’s dashboard, APIs, and integrations using logs, system tools, and debugging methods, exercising judgment about when to resolve vs. when to escalate.
Maintain accurate ticket hygiene, timely follow-ups, clear statuses, and deliver within established service level agreements (SLAs).

title: IT Officer – MIS System Support
category: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology
description:
Role Summary
The IT Officer – MIS System Support will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, maintenance, security, and operational support of the Aurum MFI MIS system. The successful candidate will serve as the dedicated technical focal point for the system, ensuring its availability, data integrity, proper user access management, timely backups, and effective coordination with relevant departments, software developers, and external technical support providers.

Duties and Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
1. MIS System Administration
Manage and monitor the day-to-day operation of the Aurum MFI MIS system.
Create, configure, update, suspend, and deactivate user accounts based on authorized requests.
Assign and manage user roles and access permissions in accordance with approved policies.
Maintain system configurations, operational settings, and user access records.
Monitor system performance and report technical issues, errors, or operational disruptions.
2. Data Backup and Recovery
Perform and monitor regular backups of the MIS database and related system data.
Verify backup completion and periodically test data restoration procedures.
Maintain backup logs and ensure backups are stored securely in accordance with the approved backup policy.
Coordinate with the relevant technical team to resolve backup failures and support data recovery when required.
Help ensure data integrity, availability, and business continuity.
3. Technical Support and Troubleshooting
Provide first-level technical support to MIS users and resolve routine system-related issues.
Investigate system errors, access problems, data discrepancies, and performance issues.
Document incidents, follow up on unresolved issues, and escalate complex technical problems to the relevant developers or service providers.
Coordinate system troubleshooting, bug fixes, upgrades, patches, and technical improvements.
Support system testing and verification before changes are implemented in the production environment.
4. System Maintenance and Security
Coordinate routine system maintenance and monitor system availability.
Ensure that user access is properly authorized and reviewed periodically.
Follow approved information security, data protection, and access control procedures.
Maintain technical documentation, system configuration records, backup logs, and incident reports.
Identify potential operational and security risks and report them to the relevant team.
5. Technical and Departmental Coordination
Act as the primary IT focal point for MIS-related matters.
Coordinate with the Microfinance Operations team, Finance, relevant business units, software developers, and external technical support providers.
Follow up on reported issues, requested changes, system enhancements, and pending technical tasks.
Assist in gathering business requirements and communicating them to the technical team.
6. Reporting and User Support
Prepare periodic reports on system availability, incidents, backup status, user administration, and maintenance activities.
Maintain an updated record of users, permissions, technical issues, and system changes.
Guide and assist staff in using the MIS system correctly and securely.
Provide basic user training and prepare user guides or operational instructions when necessary.
Perform other relevant IT and MIS support duties assigned by the IT Manager.

Job Requirements
Qualifications and Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in IT support, MIS support or a similar position.
Experience supporting a Management Information System (MIS), preferably in microfinance, banking, financial services, or another regulated organization.
Understanding of user administration, role-based access control, system security, and data protection.
Familiarity with web-based applications, application troubleshooting, and software maintenance.
Good documentation, reporting, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.
Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and maintain confidentiality when handling financial and customer data.
Key Competencies
Technical troubleshooting and analytical thinking.
Accuracy and attention to detail.
Accountability and ownership of assigned responsibilities.
Effective communication and teamwork.
Confidentiality and professional integrity.
Proactive monitoring and timely reporting of technical issues.

Submission Guidelines
How to Apply:
Interested and qualified candidates are invited to submit their CV and cover letter (in PDF format) to jobs@aurumaf.com
Please mention the position title “ IT Officer – MIS System Support ” in the subject line of your email.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview

description:
Job Summary
Position Summary: Ariana Medical Complex invites qualified individual IT professionals and eligible IT companies or service providers to apply for the management and support of the hospital’s information technology systems.
The selected individual or service provider will be responsible for planning, managing, maintaining, securing, and improving the hospital’s IT infrastructure and services. These services must support the hospital’s clinical, administrative, financial, and operational activities while ensuring system reliability, information security, confidentiality of patient data, and continuity of essential hospital services.
Applicants may apply under one of the following categories:
Category A – Individual IT Manager: An experienced IT professional responsible for managing the hospital’s IT operations and supervising the hospital’s IT staff.
Category B – IT Company / Service Provider: A qualified company that provides IT management services through a designated IT manager and an appropriately skilled technical team under an agreement with the hospital.
Key Responsibilities:
A. Strategic Leadership and IT Governance
Develop and implement an IT strategy aligned with the hospital’s objectives and healthcare service requirements.
Establish, review, and maintain IT policies, procedures, technical standards, and operational controls.
Advise hospital management on technology investments, digital transformation, system improvements, and IT-related risks.
Develop an annual IT work plan, including priorities, resource requirements, maintenance schedules, and improvement activities.
Ensure IT operations support the hospital’s clinical, administrative, financial, and operational departments.
B. IT Operations and Infrastructure
Manage and maintain servers, computer networks, databases, applications, workstations, printers, scanners, switches, cameras, and related equipment.
Ensure the availability, performance, reliability, and proper functioning of critical hospital IT systems.
Manage network architecture, routing, connectivity, wireless networks, internet services, email systems, and internal communications.
Coordinate installation, configuration, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of IT equipment.
Maintain an updated inventory of IT equipment, software, licenses, systems, and related assets.
Minimize service interruptions and coordinate timely resolution of technical problems.
C. Information Security and Data Protection
Protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of hospital information and patient records.
Implement appropriate access controls, user account management, password policies, endpoint protection, and security monitoring.
Establish and maintain regular data backup, restoration testing, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures.
Monitor and address cybersecurity risks, vulnerabilities, unauthorized access, malware, and other security incidents.
Ensure that access to patient information is restricted to authorized personnel and permitted purposes.
Report significant security incidents promptly to the designated hospital authority.
Ensure that hospital data is not copied, transferred, disclosed, or used without proper authorization.
D. Systems Development and Improvement
Assess, recommend, install, configure, and maintain suitable hardware, software, and technology solutions.
Support the effective operation and improvement of hospital information systems, including clinical, administrative, financial, and other approved platforms.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend cost-effective solutions that improve hospital services.
Coordinate system upgrades, software updates, equipment replacement, and technical projects.
Ensure that changes to critical systems are properly authorized, documented, tested, and implemented.
E. IT Support and Team Management
Provide or coordinate timely technical support to all hospital departments.
Supervise, guide, and evaluate hospital IT staff, where applicable.
Ensure proper allocation of IT duties, technical coverage, staff development, and performance monitoring.
Establish a system for receiving, recording, prioritizing, tracking, and resolving IT support requests.
Provide advanced technical assistance for complex IT and system-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical coverage for critical hospital services, including agreed arrangements for urgent and after-hours support.
F. Budget, Procurement, and Vendor Management
Prepare or contribute to the annual IT budget, equipment replacement plan, and maintenance requirements.
Recommend cost-effective procurement of IT equipment, software, licenses, and technical services.
Coordinate with authorized hospital departments regarding procurement specifications, vendor evaluation, and technical acceptance.
Manage technical relationships with internet providers, software vendors, equipment suppliers, and other service providers.
Monitor vendor performance, warranties, service agreements, licenses, and maintenance commitments.
Ensure that procurement and expenditure recommendations are submitted through the hospital’s approved authorization procedures.
G. Compliance, Documentation, and Reporting
Ensure compliance with hospital policies, applicable regulations, accreditation requirements, and approved information security procedures.
Maintain updated technical documentation, network diagrams, system configurations, equipment inventories, access records, and maintenance logs.
Prepare regular reports covering system availability, support requests, incidents, cybersecurity risks, completed activities, and proposed improvements.
Report major risks, service disruptions, resource gaps, and unresolved technical issues to the designated hospital authority.
Perform other relevant duties assigned by hospital leadership within the approved scope of work.
2. Confidentiality and Ownership of Hospital Information
The selected individual or company must:
Sign the required confidentiality and data protection undertaking before receiving access to hospital systems or information.
Use hospital data and systems solely for authorized purposes.
Maintain appropriate safeguards for patient information, employee records, financial information, and other confidential hospital data.
Refrain from retaining, disclosing, transferring, or using hospital information after termination of the engagement, except where expressly authorized or legally required.
Ensure that all hospital data, configurations, documentation, credentials, and other hospital-owned information remain under the hospital’s control.
Return hospital property and transfer all required records, documentation, credentials, and system access arrangements upon termination or completion of the assignment.

Job Requirements
4. Additional Requirements for Individual Applicants
Individual applicants must meet the following minimum requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. A master’s degree is an advantage.
At least five years of progressively responsible IT experience, including at least two years in a supervisory or managerial role.
Experience in server administration, network management, cybersecurity, backup systems, disaster recovery, and IT support.
Experience managing enterprise-level infrastructure; experience in a hospital or other healthcare institution is an advantage.
Strong leadership, planning, troubleshooting, communication, and decision-making skills.
High professional integrity and commitment to confidentiality and data protection.
Fluency in Dari, Pashto, and English, with the ability to communicate effectively in the languages required for the assignment.
Ability to provide the services and meet the attendance, availability, and reporting requirements agreed with the hospital.
5. Additional Requirements for IT Companies / Service Providers
Companies applying for this assignment must provide evidence of their ability to deliver reliable IT management services in a hospital environment.
Minimum requirements include:
Valid business registration and authorization to provide IT-related services under applicable Afghan laws and regulations.
Demonstrated experience in IT infrastructure management, technical support, networking, cybersecurity, systems maintenance, or related services.
A company profile describing its technical capabilities, service coverage, organizational structure, and relevant experience.
Evidence of previous relevant assignments, including client references or completion certificates where available.
A proposed service delivery team, including a designated IT Manager or Team Leader and appropriately qualified technical personnel.
CVs, educational qualifications, and relevant experience records for key personnel assigned to the hospital.
A technical proposal explaining the proposed management approach, service delivery arrangements, support coverage, escalation procedures, backup strategy, cybersecurity measures, and reporting arrangements.
A proposed service-level arrangement specifying response times, resolution targets, system monitoring, preventive maintenance, and emergency support.
A financial proposal detailing professional fees, staffing costs, maintenance charges, and any additional costs, clearly identifying applicable exclusions.
Written acceptance of the hospital’s confidentiality, patient data protection, access control, and information security requirements.
The company shall nominate a qualified person to serve as its primary contact and IT Manager for the assignment. Replacement of key personnel must be subject to prior approval by the hospital.
6. Evaluation and Selection Criteria
Applications will be evaluated according to the applicant category.
For individual applicants:
Educational qualifications and relevant certifications.
Years and relevance of IT management experience.
Technical competence and problem-solving ability.
Leadership and communication skills.
Healthcare or comparable enterprise IT experience.
Proposed approach to managing the hospital’s IT operations.
For companies / service providers:
Legal registration and eligibility.
Relevant company experience and past performance.
Qualifications and experience of the proposed IT Manager and technical team.
Technical proposal and service delivery methodology.
Availability, support coverage, cybersecurity, and continuity arrangements.
Financial proposal and overall value for money.
Ariana Medical Complex reserves the right to verify submitted documents, contact references, conduct interviews or technical assessments, request clarification, and select the applicant that best meets the hospital’s requirements, subject to its approved procedures.
7. Contractual and Administrative Arrangements
Individual applicants, if selected, shall enter into an employment or individual service contract, as determined by the hospital.
Companies, if selected, shall enter into a service agreement defining the scope of services, deliverables, staffing arrangements, service levels, payment terms, confidentiality obligations, performance monitoring, and termination conditions.
The final scope, contract duration, payment structure, working arrangements, and reporting requirements shall be agreed upon and approved by the hospital before commencement.
No applicant may access hospital systems or patient information before the required authorization and confidentiality arrangements are in place.
The hospital retains authority over strategic decisions, procurement approvals, system access authorization, and other reserved management functions.

Submission Guideline
8. Application Procedure
Interested individuals and eligible companies may submit their applications quoting the Job tile and the Vacancy Announcement Number (AMC | HRD-897) in the subject line to email.
Individual applicants should submit:
Updated CV.
Application letter.
Copies of educational certificates and relevant professional certifications.
Evidence of relevant work experience.
A brief technical approach to managing hospital IT services.
Fluency in English, Dari, and Pashto (spoken and written).
Companies / service providers should submit:
Company profile and valid registration documents.

Ummat International Hospital is seeking a qualified, motivated, and responsible ICT and HMIS Officer to provide general information technology support and ensure the effective management, monitoring, and utilization of the hospital's Hospital Management Information System (HMIS).

Provide routine technical support for computers, printers, scanners, and other IT equipment used within the hospital.

Ability to provide technical support and train staff with different levels of computer literacy.
Good understanding of data quality, information security, user access control, and patient data confidentiality.

Strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively with different hospital departments.

Communication, coordination, and teamwork.

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
Discord seeks a seasoned Data Engineer, focusing on our advertising product data. In this role, you will drive technical vision and strategy for ads data engineering in support of our ML initiatives while building and maintaining sophisticated data pipelines, datasets, and analytical tools. You will lead cross-functional initiatives to transform our advertising products through data-driven insights and mentor fellow engineers to deliver exceptional results.
This role works heavily with Data Science, Machine Learning, and product. If leading technical innovation, architecting scalable solutions, and empowering teams through data excites you, we encourage you to make a move!
What You'll Be Doing
Design and own core ads data models : fact/dim tables, canonical datasets, and aggregation layers that power delivery, measurement, targeting, attribution, and ML use cases.
Build and maintain the ML data that enables ads ranking, delivery, and targeting - including feature development, label generation workflows, intra-day training, and ML input observability to catch data quality issues before they degrade model performance.
Build conversion measurement pipelines and integrate third-party attribution data - including Conversion Attribution and Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) integrations (Adjust, AppsFlyer, Singular) - ensuring attribution accuracy and data parity across measurement surfaces.
Build batch and near real-time pipeline infrastructure across the ads ecosystem - pushing toward lower-latency data for ML and reporting use cases on our BigQuery + dbt + Dagster stack. Partnering with Data Platform on launch and success of new data processing engines to support low latency requirements..
Develop data quality frameworks, monitoring systems, automated anomaly detection, and SLA infrastructure for critical ads pipelines at massive scale.
Proactively identify foundational data infrastructure gaps - including those with broad implications across ML, measurement, and reporting - and design scalable, canonical solutions that multiple teams can depend on.
Build systems from scratch in a rapidly evolving, greenfield advertising data environment - making sound architectural decisions with incomplete information and balancing short-term delivery with long-term infrastructure investment.
Drive alignment across Data Science, ML Engineering, Ads Product, and GTM teams through clear narratives that connect data infrastructure decisions to business outcomes and revenue impact.
Mentor engineers through technical challenges, code and design reviews, and ownership of complex projects - contributing to the culture and engineering standards of the Data Engineering team team.
What you should have
5+ years of hands-on experience writing production code and architecting data pipelines with high-volume consumer data in advertising technology domains (ad delivery, ranking, targeting, identity, conversion measurement).
Deep expertise in digital advertising data engineering - specifically in ads delivery, conversion measurement, attribution pipelines, or ML feature data infrastructure. Experience with Conversion Data and APIs, MMP integrations, or identity graph infrastructure is strongly valued.
Demonstrated experience building data models in a greenfield or 0-to-1 environment where requirements change frequently, documentation is sparse, and architectural decisions are made with incomplete information.
Expert-level SQL and Python . Strong ability to design performant, maintainable data models and write production-quality pipeline code.

title: Risk&AI Manager
Software Engineer, Infrastructure
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote, US
Platform owns the foundation the company runs on: compute and deployment, reliability and on-call, CI/CD and monorepo health, developer environments, the infrastructure that model training and inference run on, and the security boundaries around all of it.
AI and agent tooling is the clearest example. You will contribute to how models are trained and served here, as well as how agents work inside our codebase: the environments they run in, the verification that makes their output trustworthy, and the review paths that keep it all legible. There is no industry standard and you’ll help form our opinions rather than inheriting one.
Our users are other engineers. Expect to spend time with all the other engineering teams, understanding their needs and building a roadmap. The scope is large, so you'll be choosing what to leave alone as much as build.
Architecture decisions here last: this is a small team covering a large surface. You'll have real room to decide things, and you'll stay close to the systems you decide about.
What you'll own
Own our platform: GCP, Kubernetes, Temporal, the GPU fleet behind cloud export, and the deploy and rollback machinery everything ships through. You'll be in the on-call rotation, and we'll expect you to make it quieter and more actionable.
The AI enablement substrate: GPU capacity, training and inference pipelines, and the reliability and cost of the systems serving models in production.
Cost is an engineering constraint: infrastructure decisions have a number attached and you're expected to make smart trade-offs. As inference grows with usage, the metering and attribution behind those numbers sit with this team.
Security comes with the systems you run : identity and access, secrets management, least-privilege boundaries, and supply-chain integrity.
Make what you build legible. Infrastructure-as-code that explains itself. Runbooks and in-repo context written for someone jumping in to help. Observability that tells you what failed and why.
Improve how the team learns and ships. Form hypotheses, instrument your work, release incrementally, and read results honestly. Strengthen the tooling, standards, tests, observability, and release practices that help the team move quickly without compromising quality.
Raise the team’s technical ambition. Provide architectural direction, thoughtful reviews, mentoring, and clear human writing.
What you bring
Required:
You have 8+ years building and operating production distributed systems, or equivalent server-side engineering with a heavy infrastructure focus.
You effectively leverage agents to multiply your impact and think critically about how and when to harness AI in your work.
You've run systems where failure was expensive, and your opinions about reliability and deployment come from consequences rather than reading.
You've carried a pager, commanded an incident, and rolled back before you understood why.
You use SLOs and error budgets as operating tools.
You’ve used a major cloud provider and Kubernetes in production, with infrastructure-as-code as your default.
You've owned an architecture or migration, from planning through launch, whose consequences outlived the project, and you can say what you'd do differently.
You've found important unowned work, scoped it, earned buy-in, and delivered it without being handed a spec.
You build a minimal repro, read the logs, and write targeted checks to prove a fix works instead of trusting output.
Experience that helps:
GPU and ML infrastructure: capacity planning, training or inference pipelines, serving cost and latency. If you haven't run a GPU fleet, experience with expensive capacity-constrained systems transfers well.
Production security engineering: IAM, secrets, supply chain, least privilege. You don't need to have held a security title, but you should have owned these boundaries for systems you ran.

Remote-First als gelebtes Modell
Wir arbeiten seit Jahren konsequent remote. Du entscheidest, von wo du am produktivsten bist – Homeoffice, Shared Office oder eine Mischung aus beidem.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Eigenverantwortung
Du kannst dir deine Arbeit im Rahmen der Projekte zeitlich flexibel über die Woche einteilen. Uns sind Verlässlichkeit im Team und transparente Kommunikation wichtiger als Präsenz am Schreibtisch.
Spannende Projekte statt Routine-Tickets
Gemeinsam finden wir Projekte, die zu deinem Profil und deiner Entwicklung passen – z. B. Plattformaufbau, Cloud-Migration, Automatisierung, Operations oder technische Schulungen bei Kund:innen.

Moderne Ausstattung & Arbeitsumgebung
Du erhältst moderne Hardware, die passende Software sowie das benötigte Equipment, damit du effizient und komfortabel arbeiten kannst.
Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen
Neben einem fairen Festgehalt bekommst du eine jährliche Beteiligung am Unternehmensgewinn. Je nach Rolle besteht zudem die Option auf einen Firmenwagen.
Transparente Feedbackkultur & Entwicklung
Wir setzen nicht auf jährliche Pflichttermine, sondern auf regelmäßige, ehrliche Gespräche auf Augenhöhe – du gibst uns Feedback, wir dir. So wissen wir alle, woran wir sind, und können unsere gemeinsamen nächsten Entwicklungsschritte gezielt unterstützen.
